chapters.title: Chapter 2190 A Ridiculous Boundary! II
paragraphs: Streams of Loot light surged towards Noah as since the Quantum Emperor was considered a weaker target who could not withstand Noah's Maximum Aeonic Output, he was being drained of everything about him even without his knowledge by the Boundary of LOOT!
Would his construct that was backed by the Fundamental Natural Law of Continuity and foundations of wisps of the Boundary of IMMORTALITY be able to bring him back when everything about him was gone?
The Quantum Emperor was gazing at Noah quizzically with caution as he spoke.
<You continue to surprise by even pulling out the authority of a Boundary, but it seems to be something defective as- BLERGH>
The Quantum Emperor had to stop his words as he found golden blood uncontrollably flowing out of his mouth.

He gazed down to see his chest and visage sunset in, his skin rapidly losing its luster as when he focused on his Aspects of Existence, he incredulously found his Body in a state of near death, while his Origin felt as dry as a desert while his soul that could pervade his Aspects of Existence to provide relief...it seemed unbelievably thin and weak!
To the extent that even the Construct hidden deep in the pockets of his Soul seemed to have fragments remaining that were being sucked away somewhere!

CONSTANTINE's Will gazed with shock and horror at such a situation as he raised his head up again, with him actually finding this motion difficult as he gazed into the eyes of the far away True Emperor of Quintessence.
He couldn't believe this being was actually doing such an unimaginable thing as he wondered...was it truly someone of this Age? Someone that had risen from the Barren Lands?!
But more than these thoughts, this Quantum Emperor actually felt fear begin to grip him.
He never thought it was even possible for him to die.
But as he saw even his construct had withered away, he wondered...would he still return reformed next time?
In the rising emotion of fear he never thought he would have, he wanted to at least understand.
"Who...are you?!"
There was no authority backed by Natural Laws in his voice.
This wasn't by choice like Noah and the Ancestral Descendants chose to do, but by force as this being didn't even have control of his faculties right now.
"Who am I?"
The True Emperor of Quintessence smiled devilishly as he watched Streams of loot surging towards him while only activating the Second Boundary Layer of LOOT.
"If you are the Extra that's currently dying, then naturally...I am the Main Character."
WAA!
His eyes shone with a light of Loot as he said this, the happiness within them not being easily contained as the Tyranny of the True Emperor of Quintessence was blooming in unpredictable ways!
Unseen golden flows of loot leaked from the Quantum Emperor as his Aspects of Existence became thinner and thinner, his Will shaking as when his hands rose...he saw them begin to turn into dust.
And even though an inexplicable emotion he never thought someone like him would feel was currently blaring, he still held a sense of hope for his construct.
Even as he turned to Dust, he would still be able to return like always, right?
He had the abstruse Fundamental Natural Law of Continuity that very few grasped. He had the Construct that had at its foundation the Boundary of IMMORTALITY!
Surely this wou-
The thoughts of the Quantum Emperor came to a stop.
The vast and expansive vision of his eyes and Will that could cover light years of Reality dimmed as immense blackness rolled in.
An existence of a special Lineage. The one propped up to be the next Emperor by the Ancestors!
He turned into glimmers of gray dust that were devoid of light as everything about it had been sucked away by a terrifying Boundary!
And seconds passed.
No reformation occurred.
No Rebirth bloomed.
There was only the sight of the True Emperor of Quintessence surrounded by a shocking light of Loot as he brought the Heart of Fate that had lost its owner near his chest and absorbed it!
Now...all that remained was the final Fundamental Treasure of Nature.
The Heart of Reality that another Dimensional Chassis had set off to attain at the same time as the Quantum Dimensional Chassis- the destination being the Main Reality where the Primordials reigned!
In the Main Reality.

A blanket of the VOID covered everything across these vast lands as well, and yet at an isolated space where 12 blazing thrones floated grandly, there was a hint of vibrant stellar light from a Heart that was atop a glorious pedestal!
A heart that at this moment, the fair hands of an exceedingly beautiful woman reached out to.
It was the Empress- the right hand woman of the True Emperor of Destiny!
Surrounding her were all Tribunal Rulers apart from a single one that had shockingly fallen, their eyes cold at this moment as The Empress voiced out while grasping the Heart of Reality.
"Before the Desolate Mausoleum is freed, we have to make sure that its Source is in the state that OPPENHEIMER seeks...for that, let us go to the Source of Reality."
WAA!
The very Source of Reality!
A location that no beings could readily access, and something that was only accessible if one had the Heart of Reality as a prerequisite!
And even then, it was hard to find and enter the Source of Reality as one would need the other Fundamental Treasures of Nature to fully gain access.
Yet The Empress sought to enter the Source of Reality as it seemed in all this...the machinations of OPPENHEIMER were still in play.
Just what did this being seek by splitting apart Reality in the last Age as he now ushered his forces to free Reality?
The Empress seemed to be the only one who fully knew as just when they were about to set off...
CRACK!
The folds of space behind one of the blazing thrones fractured as a terrifying aura surged out.
An aura that blared out with majesty only to be met with the sharp gazes and authorities of 11 Tribunal Rulers!

An aura that blared out with majesty only to be met with the sharp gazes and authorities of 11 Tribunal Rulers!

chapters.title: Chapter 2191 I'm An Impartial Looter! I
paragraphs: Grabbing the Heart of Reality in her hands, The Empress gazed forward with intense scrutiny at the being stepping into their most sacred and hidden location.
A place that for one- nobody would have even dared to find nor barge in just days ago!
But...too many things had changed in just a matter of days.
From a delicate balance of power between them and Dimensional Rulers, there was now a tremendous imbalance with Ancestral Descendants more powerful than them running around freely.
There were unknown existences rising and exceeding all others in power!
There was the True Emperor of Quintessence that had just risen to power...and this being was the one that had split apart space to appear before them now.

His solidified crown shining with grandeur and Imperial ecritures could be seen as it seemed to be a variation of his bodies, this one shining with a crimson stellar grandeur and giving off waves of Apollyon!

The recent changes these past few days and beings like this made The Empress and other Tribunal Rulers realize that things had rapidly changed out of their favor, and they had to move quickly to finish the plans in the works for too many years.
So when an existence that could cause all of these to crumble appeared...
HUUM!
The Authorities of Althea, Ezekiel, Noah, Gregory, Lombard...all 10 Tribunal Rulers beside her blared their authorities while coming to float in front of The Empress!
Althea grit her teeth as she glared at the existence that had killed Aegon and nearly killed her as she spoke softly to The Empress.
<Not all of us need to go to the Source of Reality to achieve our aims. Go, Empress. Providence has not closed off all paths for us yet.>

Althea spoke with grandiosity and valor as she saw the lips of the being that had walked into this isolated space curve upwards, his visage floating in serenely as it felt time was moving at a horrifically slow pace!

Althea could not speak for others, but as she was almost killed by this being not too long ago and he had gone to take the True Throne of Quintessence now- his power was no doubt greater as her fate and destiny...it was not the brightest at this moment.
She instinctively felt that she may not survive this!
And the other Tribunal Rulers that had stepped forth with her should also have felt the same!
She wanted to say many more things to The Empress.
She wanted to say that maybe they would all still be there to watch their aims come to fruition, that they would all follow the golden path of Providence onto grander lands.
That they would be in the company of the Great Commander once more and laugh while understanding the intricacies of Nature.
But for now, she could only show her thoughts and dedication by defending her from the being that wanted to destroy everything!
WAA!

Her body and the body of all other Tribunal Rulers illuminated and surged with a unique power as the Pure-Blooded Lineages deep within them were activated, their bodies exploding with Runic Ecritures and waves of NULLITY as they pulled out NULLITY Armaments and caused the surroundings to explode with swathes of Legions of Abominations!
Their numbers exceeded the hundreds of thousands and went to millions as they were meant to stand between the enemy before them and the one they protected!
<Empress.>

And all the Tribunal Rulers could still feel the aura of The Empress behind them as even she found it difficult to leave those she knew the most to an unknown fate, the voice of the Eminent Mastermind ringing out at this juncture.

<The Great Commander would not forgive me if I let the one he cares for the most fall under the hands of someone we should have caught on early. Go. Do what needs to be done...and we shall see each other if fate Wills it.>
Their Wills burned bright as they knew what had to be done!
And the eyes of The Empress flashed with veiled emotions as she waved her hands behind her, a rift opening as she was about to leave when...
"How touching."
BOOOM!
A cerulean light exploded and covered everything in a circular motion in an instant.

A tinge of gold covered the blazing blue light as they shockingly formed a circular domain, a single Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkrieg being cast as this Domain...held a foreign authority they had not come across before.
It was the coverage of the Essence of the Boundary of LOOT!

It made the domain of the Blitzkrieg wondrously seem like it cut off the very fabric of Reality itself, this domain being far vaster than any other one's cast before it as it contained all the Legions of Abominations and the Tribunal Rulers that called them out with a singular purpose.
"It is touching that you all would sacrifice yourselves for others, but...nobody may leave here today."
WAA!
The damming words of the True Emperor of Quintessence reverberated out as the rift that The Empress had called our fissured and faded away.

The eyes of all Tribunal Rulers became somber as they blazed with even more authority, an Ancient Tribunal Ruler under the name of Zimmer and holding the visage of an old man speaking out with power at this juncture!
<He could stand against you 4 last time and he's only just attained the True Throne. With all of us here...we may still be able to forge a path forward and even take this being down.>
A deeply forged pride of the Tribunals burned in the heart of this being as he spoke.
Althea and the others gripped their NULLITY Armaments tighter as truly...there was no other choice!
SHIING!
At this same time, the Empress brought out a heart shaking silver gray flower.
It was the Primitivus Nullity Originator that released the same blinding light of NULLITY that covered everything just like in the Quantum Dimension!
The Empress brought out an EPOCH Relic as she was backed by 10 Tribunal Rulers and Legions of Abominations- all of their eyes on a single being that continued to float towards them freely!
He was curious of the change in power.

He was curious to see how even as a prominent figure of these Barren Lands pulled out an EPOCH Relic to stand against him with all of the forces of Primordials...how would they react when his body alone had the hardness of an EPOCH III Relic and would not even be touched by their attacks?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2192 I'm An Impartial Looter! II
paragraphs: Was the power of the newly risen True Emperor of Quintessence really at the level where they couldn't stand against him?
This was a question Althea felt more than others as she still remembered the chilling blue flames that nearly burned her to Oblivion.
So while grasping her bow tightly, she first urged the millions of Abominations nearby as the other Tribunal Rulers did the same.
ROAAR!
These Beasts born of NULLITY roared out as they surged towards the smiling True Emperor of Quintessence like a tide.
A tide of Cataclysm that threatened to drown out everything!
And yet when these ferocious Beasts of different variations reached the visage of the True Emperor...
PAH!
Their claws pulsing with NULLITY never reached him as when they merely neared inches from his grandeur, they were repulsed as if he was a being they couldn't touch!
A mere damage of a few Quadrillion Values...it couldn't even come close to scraping the regality of the True Emperor!
Noah looked at this scene with marvel as he sensed the profundity his body carried.
The hardness of an EPOCH III Relic!
These beings before him couldn't even reach inches of him when they could pose danger to Dimensional Rulers days ago.
When he thought of his rapid advancements, he shook his head while releasing a burst of Haki around him in a circular motion.
Haki that carried 25 Aeonic Soul Damage Values emanated out to cover the nearest Abominations around him as the moment this blast coveted them...
SHAA!
Their composition changed from their magnificent and terrifying forms as they became nothing but dust!
<+137,698x Golden Quintessential Treasure Caches have been obtained.>
A single move of just spreading out his Haki had eliminated over a hundred thousand NULLITY Beasts as he attained Golden Quintessential Treasure Caches!

His Will wrapping around the Boundary of LOOT told him that depending on the enemies he killed, different variations of Quintessential Treasure Caches would come out since he achieved the First Boundary Layer of LOOT that made all killed enemies into Quintessential Treasure Caches.
For more powerful enemies who could aid him on his path, their Caches would be labeled Obsidian and then Crimson!
But the mere spread of his aura brought in such a haul as the Boundary of LOOT was bound to provide Noah with all the resources he would ever need in the future.
His actions of destroying the NULLITY Beasts with such each caused the Wills of the Tribunal Rulers to become even more somber, but they were Tribunal Rulers for a reason!
SHAA!
To the sides of Noah's head, a spiked Flail and a Spear of silver light surged forward for no other purpose other than decimation.
It was the visage of the Eminent Mastermind, Noah and Ezekiel.
These men's bodies exploded with power and authority as their NULLITY Armaments stuck out, yet to their dismay, the True Emperor didn't even make a move to defend!
BZZT!
Arcs of repulsive light buzzed inches away from the radiant stellar skin of their target as their weapons bathed in NULLITY never reached.
Instead, this being raised his hands towards them as they pulsed with the Essence of Relativity.

The spacetime continuum instantly became warped and twisted as a terrifying gravitational wave pulled their bodies in, Ezekiel and Noah finding their bodies within the grasp of this being right after!
They! With their identity as Tribunal Rulers!
They fell into the palms of the True Emperor of Quintessence as their necks were grasped in a shocking fashion.
Named Ones.
Beings at the hierarchy of power for Primordials as they had been actively moving for the past billions of years!
Beings that generations named their children after.
Waves of austere multicolored essence coursed over Noah's skin as he grasped the necks of such beings.

He gazed at them to see their emotions of shock and incredulity at the sheer power and oppressiveness he showed against them as they exploded out with waves of essence and authority to break away from his hands- each explosion seeming like Realities shattering and exploding as none of it had any effect on Noah!
<OOOH!>

They bellowed out with grandiosity while countless NULLITY arrows rained down as Althea and the other Tribunal Rulers reinforced them at this shocking juncture, yet none of it did anything as True Emperor Osmont shook his head with a hint of pity!
"Merely Named Ones!"
BOOM!
His hands crushed down with 100 Aeonic Damage Values while also releasing waves of 25 Aeonic Soul Damage Values, the bodies of Named Ones becoming utter dust in his hands as Noah sighed.
<2x Obsidian Quintessential Treasure Caches have been obtained.>
Two Tribunal Rulers died, but Noah sighed!
This was because he was reminded what stage of power these beings were at and how just days ago, they believed themselves to be untouchable!
He used this chance to remind himself to never fall into such a mindset.

That even though he exhibited a great level of power right now that made others seem like ants, anything could change in the grand scheme of things as he never wanted to be in the same position as these beings where he would die without even understanding how it was possible!
This was why he sighed.

Yet when the remaining Tribunal Rulers saw this scene, their Origins shuddered as they saw this devilish existence erase the life force of two of their strongest combatants with his bare hands- and he then sighed as if to say they were so weak!
They felt the waves of Destiny and fate turn dark as they could not believe this development.
This was because right after this, the True Emperor of Quintessence turned his gaze towards where the remaining Tribunal Rulers were clustered as his voice emanated out.
"I should remember not to play with my food either. After all, anything can change at any moment..."
Lessons he had learned from the many forgotten extras in the past were dredged up as he seemed ready to end all those contained in his established domain!
It was a move that caused Althea's heart to lurch and flutter as she realized at this moment that the darkened fate and destiny truly meant what they implied!
And yet she still spoke out with strength as she floated in front of the Empress with her silver Bow.
<The rest of us you may be capable of killing with no repercussions. But...touching The Empress will mean a Fate worse than death for you!>
WAA!
<Putting your hands on the Lover of the Great Commander will mean that whenever you leave these Barren Lands...death will just be around the corner for you.>
Her fate and the fate of other Tribunal Rulers may not be too bright.
But the Empress activating the Primitivus Nullity Originator while gazing coldly at Noah...she could not fall.
The plans of the Great Commander lay with her. The Heart of Reality lay with her!
Yet towards her words...the True Emperor of Quintessence shook his head as the waves of Apollyon emanating destruction surged around him.
His expression was one of righteousness and mercy as he shook his head while replying to her.
"Do not worry. I am not someone that considers one being more important than another. I shall treat you all equally as I am an impartial looter!"
WAA!
Whether it was a regular Tribunal Ruler or The Empress, why did it matter? Did Noah fear the oh-so-grand OPPENHEIMER? Did he fear the wrath of the Ancestors to go against their will?
The answer was no.
So to the dismay of Althea and all other Tribunal Rulers...
"Quintessential Singularity Ignition."
HOOONG!
Sparkling blue flames were ignited.
They bloomed all around as their aim...was to burn everything enclosed in this space!

chapters.title: Chapter 2193 The Source Of Reality! I
paragraphs: 2193 The Source of Reality! I
The falls of Empires were always unique to observe.
No strong power truly believed that at the height of their power and majesty, they could somehow be toppled
over!
Especially so in such a short period of time, and by another power that wasn't even a contender against them for the past years.
When the fall did happen, it was only noticed at the last possible moment.
At this juncture, the pupils of powerful Emperors that reigned over Reality after the True Emperor of Destiny was gone shone with a blue light as they realized this.

The Tribunal Rulers that controlled vast stretches of Reality saw the surging Ignition of Flames of a Singularity that latched onto Abominations and decimated them as if they were stalks of wheat on a dry field- and they saw these flames coming towards them with even greater ferocity as they knew!
Their fate and destiny instantly turned dark as even their wisps of understanding of Providence told them this
was it!
It was a terrifying thought in one's mind to know they were about to die, and people accepted this thought differently as some accepted it, while some struggled.

Althea looked at the coming flames that threatened their extinction as feeling the breath of The Empress behind her, she cried out mournfully at what was to come and the madman who didn't even consider the status of this personage behind her.
She cried out mournfully as her soul burned and she released the strongest attack she could have mustered throughout her whole life!
She cried out mournfully and with valor as she wasn't able to see the Great Commander again after all this!
She cried-
BOOOM!
Her blinding surge of silver light that was bursting out was instantly devoured by cerulean flames as it didn't
matter if it was her strongest or weakest attack, it was instantly devoured by the Quintessential flames as her figure was turned to cinders right after.
The Damage Output of the True Emperor of Quintessence was too massive at this moment.
He had yet to pair himself against the Ancestral Descendants and see exactly how they would fare with the Boundaries they controlled, but the Rulers of the Barren Lands would not be an issue for him!
After all, he had decimated the strongest Quantum Emperor before coming here!
<8x Obsidian Quintessential Treasure Caches have been obtained.>

Everything burned under the cerulean domain as the 8 remaining Tribunal Rulers apart from the Eminent Mastermind Noah and Ezekiel joined them in death, the tongues of the flames surging towards the visage of the woman cradling an EPOCH Relic at this moment.
Her eyes held a hint of frustration and anger as she was close to achieving something only to have it taken away, but the one thing she didn't have...was fear.
In the face of death, why wouldn't one have fear?
BZZT!
The flames carried tens of Aeonic Damage Values surged around her body as just like the others, the
defenses of The Empress were utterly shredded in an instant!
And yet just as the flames were about to erase all her Vitality Values...
BOOM!
Her soul illuminated as a verdant barrier of terrifying life force erupted to cover her!
And yet...
CRACK!
This barrier was latched onto by the flames and also devoured right after as they sought to decimate her Aspects of Existence next!

It seemed she had multiple life saving measures that initiated the moment that her life was in danger, but even these weren't enough as after the verdant barrier was shattered, her body was instantly aflame as it began to burn along with her Origin.
These 2 aspects of existence were instantly decimated as when the tongues of blue flames reached out to burn her Soul...
DING!
A ringing sound emanated out that stopped everything.

Her body and Origin were destroyed as right when the third aspect of existence was about to undergo the same process, a blinding white gold light emanated from it as from afar, Noah instantly recognized it as the light of a Boundary.
A Boundary!

It wasn't IMMORTALITY or NULLITY, but something just as pristine as the moment it bloomed out, Noah already silently activated Active Loot Absorption and designated this light covering the soul of The Empress!
A light that kept the cerulean flames at bay as from it, Noah could almost feel a raging and rising will that could oppress an entire Age.
"It seems that the True Emperor of Destiny truly loved you."
Noah uttered silently amidst the raging flames as his figure came closer, his eyes on the golden cylindrical paths of light that showed fantastical prompts.
<+.01 Shard of the Boundary of DESTINY.>
<+.01 Shard of the Boundary of DESTINY.>
The True Emperor of Destiny had taken his prime concept and expanded its Boundary towards EXTREMITY.

And it now wrapped around the soul of his beloved as just when it seemed a Will was about to rouse from the white gold light covering the Empress, it instantly fluctuated and roared out with anger as it flashed with majesty- turning into a point of light that shot towards the cerulean Boundary Noah had enacted and passed through it after slight resistance!

It noticed the constant leaking of its Source towards a terrifying enemy as the authority of the Boundary of DESTINY wrapping around the soul of The Empress instantly chose to leave, bypassing the Boundary of LOOT covering Noah's Domain and only leaving behind crackling flames!

Noah looked at this scene sharply as the soul of the Empress was whisked away too quickly, his authority bypassed as it seemed the Boundary of DESTINY had to have been expanded by multiple Boundary Layers to be capable of bypassing his at this juncture.
It showed the True Emperor of Destiny truly lived up to his name.
It showed that OPPENHEIMER was still someone to be gazed at carefully and understood!

The cerulean flames in the surroundings began dying down as twinkling silver lights of NULLITY Armaments were all that remained, 12 thrones fractured and utterly burnt as one of the more dazzling points of lights..was an EPOCH Relic in the form of a flower and a shining multicolored Heart of Reality.

sentences.text: 2193 The Source of Reality!
I
The falls of Empires were always unique to observe.
No strong power truly believed that at the height of their power and majesty, they could somehow be toppled
over!
Especially so in such a short period of time, and by another power that wasn't even a contender against them for the past years.
When the fall did happen, it was only noticed at the last possible moment.
At this juncture, the pupils of powerful Emperors that reigned over Reality after the True Emperor of Destiny was gone shone with a blue light as they realized this.

The Tribunal Rulers that controlled vast stretches of Reality saw the surging Ignition of Flames of a Singularity that latched onto Abominations and decimated them as if they were stalks of wheat on a dry field- and they saw these flames coming towards them with even greater ferocity as they knew!
Their fate and destiny instantly turned dark as even their wisps of understanding of Providence told them this
was it!
It was a terrifying thought in one's mind to know they were about to die, and people accepted this thought differently as some accepted it, while some struggled.

Althea looked at the coming flames that threatened their extinction as feeling the breath of The Empress behind her, she cried out mournfully at what was to come and the madman who didn't even consider the status of this personage behind her.
She cried out mournfully as her soul burned and she released the strongest attack she could have mustered throughout her whole life!
She cried out mournfully and with valor as she wasn't able to see the Great Commander again after all this!
She cried-
BOOOM!
Her blinding surge of silver light that was bursting out was instantly devoured by cerulean flames as it didn't
matter if it was her strongest or weakest attack, it was instantly devoured by the Quintessential flames as her figure was turned to cinders right after.
The Damage Output of the True Emperor of Quintessence was too massive at this moment.
He had yet to pair himself against the Ancestral Descendants and see exactly how they would fare with the Boundaries they controlled, but the Rulers of the Barren Lands would not be an issue for him!
After all, he had decimated the strongest Quantum Emperor before coming here!
<8x Obsidian Quintessential Treasure Caches have been obtained.>

Everything burned under the cerulean domain as the 8 remaining Tribunal Rulers apart from the Eminent Mastermind Noah and Ezekiel joined them in death, the tongues of the flames surging towards the visage of the woman cradling an EPOCH Relic at this moment.
Her eyes held a hint of frustration and anger as she was close to achieving something only to have it taken away, but the one thing she didn't have...was fear.
In the face of death, why wouldn't one have fear?
BZZT!
The flames carried tens of Aeonic Damage Values surged around her body as just like the others, the
defenses of The Empress were utterly shredded in an instant!
And yet just as the flames were about to erase all her Vitality Values...
BOOM!
Her soul illuminated as a verdant barrier of terrifying life force erupted to cover her!
And yet...
CRACK!
This barrier was latched onto by the flames and also devoured right after as they sought to decimate her Aspects of Existence next!

It seemed she had multiple life saving measures that initiated the moment that her life was in danger, but even these weren't enough as after the verdant barrier was shattered, her body was instantly aflame as it began to burn along with her Origin.
These 2 aspects of existence were instantly decimated as when the tongues of blue flames reached out to burn her Soul...
DING!
A ringing sound emanated out that stopped everything.

Her body and Origin were destroyed as right when the third aspect of existence was about to undergo the same process, a blinding white gold light emanated from it as from afar, Noah instantly recognized it as the light of a Boundary.
A Boundary!

It wasn't IMMORTALITY or NULLITY, but something just as pristine as the moment it bloomed out, Noah already silently activated Active Loot Absorption and designated this light covering the soul of The Empress!
A light that kept the cerulean flames at bay as from it, Noah could almost feel a raging and rising will that could oppress an entire Age.
"It seems that the True Emperor of Destiny truly loved you."
Noah uttered silently amidst the raging flames as his figure came closer, his eyes on the golden cylindrical paths of light that showed fantastical prompts.
<+.01 Shard of the Boundary of DESTINY.>
<+.01 Shard of the Boundary of DESTINY.>
The True Emperor of Destiny had taken his prime concept and expanded its Boundary towards EXTREMITY.

And it now wrapped around the soul of his beloved as just when it seemed a Will was about to rouse from the white gold light covering the Empress, it instantly fluctuated and roared out with anger as it flashed with majesty- turning into a point of light that shot towards the cerulean Boundary Noah had enacted and passed through it after slight resistance!

It noticed the constant leaking of its Source towards a terrifying enemy as the authority of the Boundary of DESTINY wrapping around the soul of The Empress instantly chose to leave, bypassing the Boundary of LOOT covering Noah's Domain and only leaving behind crackling flames!

Noah looked at this scene sharply as the soul of the Empress was whisked away too quickly, his authority bypassed as it seemed the Boundary of DESTINY had to have been expanded by multiple Boundary Layers to be capable of bypassing his at this juncture.
It showed the True Emperor of Destiny truly lived up to his name.
It showed that OPPENHEIMER was still someone to be gazed at carefully and understood!

The cerulean flames in the surroundings began dying down as twinkling silver lights of NULLITY Armaments were all that remained, 12 thrones fractured and utterly burnt as one of the more dazzling points of lights..was an EPOCH Relic in the form of a flower and a shining multicolored Heart of Reality.

chapters.title: Chapter 2194 The Source Of Reality! II
paragraphs: 2194 The Source of Reality! ll

Noah gazed at the torn fabric of Reality as his hurting flames of Singularity receded, waving his hands to collect the NULLITY Armaments and the Primitivus Nullity Originator that he only gave a glance to before his focus came to the Fundamental Treasure of Nature before him.
The Heart of Reality!
Inside of his body at this moment, he had collected the Hearts of Destiny, Fortune, Karma, and Fate as now..he got his hands on the Heart of Reality!
All of the Fundamental Treasures of Nature were within his grasp as with them, even greater control of Reality was granted.
"Come."
WAA!

Noah beckoned to the Heart of Reality as it sunk into his chest- being transferred into the Main Body at the depths of the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature and coming to position itself stably beside his Heart of Mana as the other four Fundamental Treasures of Nature circled them with majesty.
Waves of a profound authority emanated around him as prompts descended.
<You have brought all the Fundamental Treasures of Nature under your banner.>
<Your Providence exceeds all others in this Age and Ages past as you gain an unprecedented level of control over the Fabric of Reality!>
<When gaining access to the Source of Reality with the Heart of Reality and the guidance of the other Fundamental Treasures of Nature, the possibility to completely affect Dimensions opens.>

Noah had enough Authority of this Age and Era to easily Displace 3 Dimensions- and this wasn't counting the unknown reserves of the True Authority of Quintessence that were waiting for him through his True Throne!
He had asked Reality itself whether it expected him to use this Authority to free it, and the answer was that he didn't necessarily need to.
3 Dimensions could be displaced with the help of Reality, and if he got his hands on the Fundamental Treasures of Nature- he could even displace the existences within it!

He could remove the Ancestral Descendants stretched throughout the Dimensions and safely assimilate these planes onto his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality as thereafter..he could judge how to maneuver with the remaining Dimensions.

Even in the Main Reality he was in and the Desolate Mausoleum, Ancestral Descendants waded through calmly while surrounded by the VOID as since Noah did not want to clash with them yet, he wouldn't hastily try devouring the fabric of the Main Reality.
There was no harm in continuing to amass power as Noah had two options from here on out.
Meet and fight the Ancestral Descendants as he had tough battles where a winner or loser would be hard to decide, or fight them at his absolute peak of power when he could trash them!
He knew himself and which path he would choose.
Besides, he didn't have to devour the fabric of Reality where Ancestral Descendants roamed when he had a much better option.
When he had a place that nobody but him could even access!
"Lead me.."
The voice of his Main Body in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality emanated out grandly as his Will descended on the Fundamental Treasures of Nature he had collected from all Clones.
"Lead me to the Source of Reality!"
HOOONG!
His gaze was far reaching.
He didn't have to devour the fabric of Reality as..what if he simply swallowed up the very Source of Reality itself?

This would have been the final step after Noah swallowed up all Dimensions and Realities, but if he could truly access it now..why couldn't he see if it was feasible for him to Bind or Devour it like the Sources of Nature?!
The Sources of Manadynamics, Relativity, Providence...all of the Sources of Nature that Noah had half bound to himself were what comprised the Source of Reality.
After all, Reality was made up of the Natural Laws that maintained it.
In the Source of Reality, all of the Natural Laws and Fundamental Natural Laws would be contained.
Anything Noah knew or didn't know would be there.

There were many possibilities to what could come of this as in the far reaches of the Dimensional Empyral Domain of Nature, a multicolored stellar spatial tunnel of a singularity formed that led into the folds of the very fabric of Reality.

The Heart of Reality within Noah pulsed while releasing rays of multicolored light that seemingly enacted the spatial bridge leading into the folds of space, his Main Body stepping into it as for the first time in quite a long
period of time for him...he left the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!
The True Emperor of Quintessence himself entered a unique pathway into the folds of Reality as one had to
wonder..just where would the very Source of Reality be located?
Was it not at the very center of the Main Reality where one had Empyral Domains on Nature swirling with a myriad of natural laws?
The most obvious place actually was not it as Reality was pervasive across the Desolate Mausoleum and Dimensions.
Its Source was hidden within its very folds in a spatial plane that no being should truly step in.
Because within the Source of Reality, one wrong move could spell catastrophe for everything.
And yet the Will of Reality had guided Noah to the other Fundamental Treasures of Nature required to access this location.
The same location that The Empress wished to go to in order to complete the plans of OPPENHEIMER!
SHIING!

Noah's will was vibrant as he crossed a tunnel that was built with Fundamental Natural Law, his feet cascading across a multicolored bridge made of Manadynamics, Entropy, Providence, Relativity..and as he went further in, he began to see tendrils of Natural Laws he did not yet have understanding in build the very spacetime bridge he walked on.

He very quickly recognized the blinding light of Continuity and a few other points of light shining with grandiosity- everything around him buzzing with grandeur and authority as he knew he was moving countless Light years with every step he took.
He could have been moving from one end of Reality to another, or traversing across different planes of Dimensions with every step in this unique tunnel he was in!
It felt like traversing across a massive Singularity of Infinite mass and density as in an indeterminate period of time...
WAA!!
Noah felt like he had reached the end of the line.

His 9 Dimensional Realities pulsed as his Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation caused his body to Illuminate like a natural treasure, his Will billowing out maddeningly towards a blinding source of light- towards the very Source of Reality!

<Quintessential Aeonic Ascendancy Stanchions>:: Your Ascendancy Stanchions have further evolved due to your Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation. They are now capable of passively elevating all Flames of Edicts within it to the highest possible level, with all current edicts being infused with Natural Laws or Decreta to reach the stage of DHARMA or HERESY. When all concepts within a Stanchion are elevated to their highest level, they will resonate with each other to passively produce Boundary Pearls within your Origin- a type of treasure that can take you just a little bit further towards EXTREMITY, and is utilizable by all Boundaries...

chapters.title: Chapter 2195 The Source of Reality! III
paragraphs: His eyes were blinded by brilliance as by the time he could see again, he found himself in a space of pure fantasy.
His Origin was actually the first to 'feel' as it cried out with fervor, the completed Dimensional Realities echoing out joy at the overabundance of extremely pure essence in the surroundings!

And it was pristinely pure as Noah felt like he was swimming in waves of plasma of the Natural Laws, austere and pristinely beautiful multicolored tendrils of light surging all around him as they screamed purity.
This whole space was covered by these plasmic multicolored waves of pure authority!
Unimaginable purity as just the tendrils of Manadynamics here were a color of blue that would blind normal existences!
And these tendrils of blue swam in a circular motion across this space as they came from a single source.
A source of the brightest light around this space as when Noah gazed at it, he could only describe it as a massive spinning multicolored Singularity.
It weaved in the tendrils of the Fundamental Natural Laws of Manadynamics, Relativity, Providence, Entropy, Continuity...and one more abstruse Fundamental Natural Law!
Noah's will gazed upon it and focused on this pristine white essence that he instantly got the name of as...
"Isochronism..."
WAA!
The Fundamental Natural Law of Isochronism!
This Natural Law and Continuity were the two hardest and most abstruse laws to grasp as Isochronism dealt with cycles.
The cycles of life and death. The cycles of creation and destruction. The cycles of Ages that come and go.

It was something so pristine and at the center of the Barren Lands as aside from these massive plasmic tendrils of Fundamental Natural Laws, Noah also saw 9 tendrils of thinner laws of nature that swirled around the spinning multicolored Singularity.
He focused on those he knew and those he didn't as their information rose before him!
It was the Natural Laws of Polarity, Gravitation, Weak Nuclear Force, Strong Nuclear Force, Electromagnetism, Oscillation, Elasticity, Uncertainty, and Isotropy.
9 Natural Laws that matched the 9 Decreta, and 6 Fundamental Natural Laws that stood above them!
Pristine waves of these different concepts flowed as in the midst of all this, Noah also saw plasmic waves of the 9 Dimensions- these also being a part of Reality.

The waves of Dream, Avalon, and Apollyon were surging with peace and serenity while the tendrils of the remaining 6 Dimensions...they coagulated to form into grandiose multi-colored nail-like stakes that pierced into the spinning Singularity that was the Source of Reality!
These pikes were extremely similar to the scene Noah saw when he finished forming Dimensional Layers, but now...he would have the authority to pull out 3 seamlessly.

The Fundamental Treasures of Nature inside him pulsed as he floated closer and closer to the gloriously spinning Singularity, his body releasing an absorptive force to take in the Essence of all the Natural Laws he had yet to fully grasp as he spoke while focusing on the verdant, golden, and multicolored pikes of the Prana, Elysium and Quantum Dimensions!
"Designate the Prana, Elysium, and the Quantum Dimensions as the first ones to undergo Displacement."
His Origin vibrated ever so slightly.

He knew that what he was about to do was something utterly unfathomable as he grasped the sheer grandiosity of it, and the results would only further cement his supremacy as he could not wait to do it!
And yet...

<<The Displacement of the Quantum Dimension will shatter the Pylon of Ascension and instantly alert those on the other side of it. Even if the VOID prevents the changes of the removal of the Anchors from being felt, the Displacement of the Quantum Dimension will alert them and cause the factor of uncertainty to rise that much more. It is the easiest pathway to utilize in descending and Ascending, but it is not the only one. As soon as they confirm the destruction of the Pylon of Ascension while not being able to communicate with all of their forces, an even stronger force will undoubtedly descend.>>
The booming Will of Reality emanated out as Noah's eyes flashed sharply.
Countless ideas flowed in his mind as the Will of Reality continued.

<<Analyzing your current level of power, there is a high probability of matching against normal Ancestral Descendants with the level of Boundaries they have achieved and the current restriction of Natural Laws. But there are the Ancestral Descendant Commanders known as Yvonne, Hideyoshi, and Theseus on top of True Empress Katya. These beings should have achieved a Third or Fourth Boundary Layer towards EXTREMITY in an unknown number of Boundaries. Unless you elevate your own, you are still off from overcoming them completely.>>
The Will emanating out was emotionless as it actually gave Noah a glimpse between his abilities and his enemies!
<<This isn't to mention the Eight Tier Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE that is currently dominating Yvonne in the Niflheim Dimension. I cannot analyze the discrepancy between you and him.>>
The existence that had been scheming since before even OPPENHEIMER rose!
There were many parties to account for as the waters couldn't be muddied anymore with terrifying Legions that the Ancestors could send.
There was no harm in playing events covertly while making great progress- Noah not allowing his great elevation in power to blind him from being careful!
After all, it was when one was at the peak of their pride and arrogance that they fell.
He had seen this too many times.
So he turned from the Quantum Dimension as he gazed at other candidates, the Will of Reality continuing to emanate out.

<<Resonate your Dimensional Realities with the Fundamental Treasures of Nature as well as my Source. You can connect your Dimensional Realities to the Dimensions with the Authority of this Era as with all prerequisites met, you can both displace the existences within Dimensions and the Dimensions themselves.>>
WAA!
Resonance.
Displacement of both Dimensions and the Existences within it!
"Hooo..."
He breathed out while feeling his vibrant Dimensional Layers.
His Will then covered the Fundamental Treasures of Nature as he then gazed at the Source of Reality.

He had to take all of these constructs and pair them with the Authority of this Era that his Origin had been accumulating and resonate everything...and only when he entered a fantastical state of Resonance could he undertake the act of Displacement of Dimensions!
HOONG!
An austere symphony began to play as the True Emperor of Quintessence absorbed the essence of Natural Laws while beginning to resonate with the very Source of Reality.
The result of his actions was bound to be astonishing as he began on a great undertaking!

paragraphs: 2196 The True Emperor of Destiny! |
While Noah's main body began a great undertaking, his clones had their own designated tasks as one clone in particular was worthy of mentioning.
With hair shining radiantly with a halcyon gleam, it was the Elysium Dimensional Chassis that was surrounded by intense waves of Providence.
He was currently at the deepest area of the Soul Library which only he had access to so far, his figure floating
atop a stellar multicolored crystalline floor as his surroundings were akin to a star-filled space, and one could see dazzling ancient books and grimoires floating around serenely in this space!

Some of these grimoires were labeled [Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Technique- Fourth Form], [Exerpts From the Age of Genesis], [Analysis of Mana and NULLITY]...there were a myriad of titles for these grimoires as they contained information Noah considered important, and he was taking it upon himself to record it down as something akin to a hobby!

Currently, the Elysium Dimensional Chassis was adorned in loose fitting golden pants and a tight fitting shirt that showed the astounding foundation of a body that Noah had sculpted, the rims of a relic in the form of glasses sitting on the bridge of his nose as it shimmered with waves of NULLINIUM and MANANIUM!

It was actually one of the relics that another one of Noah's clones who was working on the Blacksmith's Forge had produced- one that reached EPOCH | after Noah began utilizing the materials he gained to make different Relics! These glasses were identified as
<Aeonic Emperor's Spectacles> as they furthered Noah's inquisitive eyes and their capabilities of seeing through nature among other things!
With such fantastical adornments, Noah floated atop the stellar multicolored crystalline floor as a thick golden book lay before his eyes.

It was a book labeled [The Age of Destiny] as it gave off austere waves of ancientness, Noah's Will serenely surging into this book as it was inscribing all of the details from the memories Noah had attained over the past days from his enemies!
From the Dimensional Rulers he killed in the Dimensional Conclave to the Tribunal Rulers he killed just recently, his

Will inscribed it in words that when one placed their essence into, they could experience the very memories that Tribunal Rulers and Dimensional Rulers of the different dimensions had across the past Age.
Concurrently, Noah was perusing through Billions of years worth of memories between Althea, Ezekiel..all of the named ones and how the events of the past Age truly unfolded!
He was also able to learn about the being that was at the center of controversy.
OPPENHEIMER!

Shockingly, the memories of Althea and the others about him were veiled as even while going through mere memories, Noah was only able to unlock the memories about OPPENHEIMER by utilizing the Authority of the Boundary of LOOT!
And from that, he had seen this True Emperor.
He was learning about this being's beginnings as well as the path he took as while Noah inscribed all of it down, he couldn't help but mutter with raised eyes.
"Were you actually the main character?"

The journey this being took was a unique one as rising from absolutely nothing, he had come to reign over the Pure-Blooded Primordial Lineages and even triumph over Chosen Emperor and Destined Emperors to become the True Emperor of the Age of Destiny.
From the memories of the Tribunal Rulers, Noah could feel immense reverence and respect.
And as he perused through things he already theorized or knew, he came across some memories that finally bore fruit in his search for Knowledge.
It was a memory Althea had as she was more trusted by The Empress, and she had followed her on a day that OPPENHEIMER had called for her.
The memories flowed into words and mixed with each other as a fantastical scene bloomed.
At the depths of Reality itself.
Multicolored streams of natural laws weaved together into a massive Empyral Domain of Nature tens of times in size compared to the ones seen in the Age of Quintessence.
These tendrils of essence were dense in concentration as in such a place one could easily grasp the laws of nature at a fast pace!

In such a location, a golden throne floated silently and gazed out into the incandescent waves of light as behind this throne, the figure of The Empress appeared, Althea floating behind her as if she was a maidservant while she gazed towards the man on the True Throne of Destiny with reverence!
<I plan to go through with it.>
WAA!
His voice was deep and magnetic.
Even though he sat on the golden throne, one could see his vibrant dark hair cascading close to his shoulders as Althea's eyes could barely catch a glimpse of his sharp nose!

<Desiderius will eventually destroy everything if things do not go his way, so | will act like | am following his will and destabilize everything. | cannot undo what the Ancestors did a long time ago, but | can do something different with my current Authority.>
His words were shocking for The Empress to hear as she came closer to the True Throne, Althea not being able to bring herself to go as she waited behind.
She could only see the caution and care in the eyes of the Empress as she went on to grasp the hand of the True Emperor.
<It never felt right dealing with this NOBLESSE. Is he not the enemy of our people? Isn't he doing all this to hurt our ancestors?>
Care and yearning could be felt in her eyes as The Empress actually tried to sway the True Emperor, with this being sighing at such a juncture as he stared at the expanse of colors around him!

<I understand this more than you can even imagine..but it is what must be done. The Boundary of DESTINY tells me so. And when it comes to them being enemies to our people..our people are only those who care for us. Not some abstruse past Lineages that no longer care for these lands. We will protect our people. We will do everything we can to protect those we care for. And for anyone standing in the way of this- whether it be the Ancestors or the NOBLESSE...they will all be crushed under the weight of DESTINY.>
BOOOM!

A heavy and shocking will erupted and blared out domineeringly as it was too potent for the still weak Althea, her mind blanking out at such a juncture and only waking up later to the sight of the Empress gazing at a man on a throne that was shining with utmost radiance.
He was shining with a shocking amount of golden radiance as the Authority of this entire Age accessible
through the True Throne..he had begun directing it for only a single purpose.
Others say the Primordials did it because they were greedy for even more resources and even more Realities. To stretch their hands even across the Parallel Paths and Dimensions!
The Primordials believed in a higher purpose as among all the differing opinions..who knew where the truth lay!
<Author's Note>:: Revision of the 9 Natural Laws of Nature! From the Natural Laws of Polarity, Gravitation,

Weak Nuclear Force, Strong Nuclear Force, Electromagnetism, Vacillation, Steady State, Uncertainty, and Isotropy to >> Natural Laws of Polarity, Gravitation, Weak Nuclear Force, Strong Nuclear Force, Electromagnetism, Oscillation, Elasticity, Uncertainty, and Isotropy
<<Prompt of the Loot from NULLITY Beast Legions summoned by Tribunal Rulers.>>:: +7,468,553x Golden Quintessential Treasure Caches have been obtained.

chapters.title: Chapter 2197 The True Emperor Of Destiny! II
paragraphs: 2197 The True Emperor of Destiny! II
A change in the very winds of Destiny.
A change brought about when the True Emperor of Destiny illustriously sat on his Throne and accessed the key that led to the True Authority of Destiny of the whole Age!
When Noah analyzed this portion of the memories, he came to wonder about himself and how he would utilize the True Authority of Quintessence.
It could be utilized on the remaining 3 Dimensions after Noah displaced the ones he could as mentioned by the
Will of Reality- achieving the reality of first displacing the enemies within the Dimensions and then displacing the Dimensions themselves.

It could also be utilized on something that would expand his power stupendously, where he could direct the True Authority of Quintessence to expand the Boundary of LOOT or even further..enact a second Boundary that Noah had to have!
"The Boundary of QUINTESSENCE..."
Waves of golden light surged around Noah in this space as he spoke out while viewing the illusory scene of OPPENHEIMER utilizing his authority to split apart Reality itself.
He had spoken about doing this as it would match his aims while also doing what the one called Desiderius wished for!
The 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE, Desiderius!

To face such a being that the Will of Reality itself and the True Emperor of Genesis were wary of, Noah needed to expand his Boundary of LOOT as much as possible while he also wanted to enact the Boundary of QUINTESSENCE.
To expand on this Modus Operandi of exceeding all others towards EXTREMITY as he still needed to have the strength to stave off his enemies while he assimilated all Dimensions!
He had to have such strength as even while he analyzed OPPENHEIMER at the peak of his power splitting apart Reality, he was still forced away from the Desolate Mausoleum soon after!
The memories of those that fell to him illuminated the past and filled in the gaps of knowledge, but that was it.
The past was the past, and Noah had to forge his own future!
SHAA!

The eyes of the clone returned to the memories of the Age of Destiny as a True Emperor carried out an Irreversible Nexus Event, while at this same time- his Main Body was about to carry out multiple Irreversible Nexus Events!
Resonance.
Achieving the same wavelength and simply being in tune with another construct!
When one resonated with Nature, they could peer into the secrets of Natural Laws and increase their understanding.
At this juncture, Noah was resonating with multiple different constructs as his overly strong Quintessential
Aeonic Soul felt closely connected to the Fundamental Treasures of Nature, his own Origin, and the Source of Reality as the Authority of this Era permeated through each of these constructs!
BZZZT!
As this occurred, Noah also received prompts on a side quest he was undertaking while he was here.
<Your Understanding of the Fundamental Natural Law of Isochronism has increased.>
<Your Understanding of the Natural Law of Electromagnetism has increased.>
<Your Understanding of the Natural Law of Elasticity has..>
<Your Understanding of the Natural Law of Uncertainty...>
<Your Understanding of the Natural Law of Isotropy....>

His Origin was akin to a dry desert that drank in the surrounding plasmic tendrils of Natural Laws, and he gained understanding at a fast pace as from his Expansive Space, Natural Decretum Seeds were already rising to elevate the understanding of these new laws to completion!
With this accomplishment occurring on the sides, his focus was still on the task at hand as waves of power and authority buzzed joyously while his Will emanated out at this moment.
"The first one shall be Prana.."
A point of verdant light erupted at the Prana Dimensional Reality came under focus and outshone all others.
He had gotten the information from the Will of Reality that the Ancestral Descendant Commander known as
Yvonne had Prana along with the Mirror Dimension and Niflheim- and she was personally battling with the 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE- Desiderius, at this moment in Niflheim!
So the only ones in the Niflheim and Mirror Dimensions were Ancestral Descendants!
"Ancestral Descendants...”
In the midst of his Resonance, a thought arose in Noah's mind about a different possible direction.
It wasn't a thought brought to fruition through Destiny or Providence that began to churn wildly with opportunity!
It was the Boundary of LOOT.
And it asked...did things really have to play out this way?

As he asked this question, he felt his strong soul become stretched out as it covered all of his Prana Dimensional Reality, and then his 'vision' changed as he felt what his soul could see become expanded even further!

He felt a unique connection as it wasn't just his own Dimensional Layer that he was currently looking at, with his consciousness seemingly melding with the very fabric of Reality as he could see the genuine Prana Dimension!
As if the VOID did not exist, everything was clear.
He saw the rifts of NULLITY stretching throughout.
He felt the vibrant life forms and force of life emanating throughout this Dimension.
And soon enough..he was able to locate the Legion of Ancestral Descendants that belonged to Commander Yvonne- their bodies bright with the Authority of a Boundary!
Noah was gazing at them and their positions as they moved around carefully, where his consciousness was seemingly connected to Reality itself for him to view all this.

And if he wished..he could utilize this unique state brought about with the Resonance of his Origin, Fundamental Treasures of Nature, and the Source of Reality that were all tied with the Authority of this Era to displace these Ancestral Descendants and then this Dimension entirely!
But..he stopped and didn't carry out this step.
He had a set path he wanted to follow.
But he had also gotten new information.

And the Boundary of LOOT saw great opportunity from this information as Noah's initial plan of completely elevating his power to another level before facing the Ancestral Descendants..the Boundary of LOOT wanted it to change!

After getting the information from the Will of Reality that the only enemies he couldn't overcome were the Ancestral Descendant Commanders and that he should be able to match the normal Descendants in their Legions, Noah felt the need to change his set path!
He didn't have to use one of the three chances that allowed him to displace existences and the Dimension they were in if the Dimension...only had the Ancestral Descendants and not their Commanders.

He could follow the original route of him devouring these Dimensions with the Pocket Dimensional Reality as at this moment, Reality had changed to the extent that he could battle and hold off these Descendants- if not possibly kill them due to his ridiculous Boundary of LOOT.
A new path full of grander possibilities opened up before his eyes!

chapters.title: Chapter 2198 Utter Desecration Of Logic! I
paragraphs: 2198 Utter Desecration of Logic! |
A new path to take!
The Boundary of LOOT was like an impatient child sending its thoughts to Noah and saying this was the best way to do it. And Noah was altering his mind and plans on this new path already.

The 3 chances of Displacement..he altered his mind to shift them to the Dimensions that had Ancestral Descendant Commanders, NOBLESSE, and the Quantum Dimension as the last one as if he did it this way, he may not even have to clash with the most powerful enemies before he completely removed the shackles of the Desolate Mausoleum and assimilated all Dimensions!
HOOONG!
Only now did Providence and Destiny begin to buzz wildly.
In his unique state of Resonance, Noah smiled devilishly as he enacted a new path with the lead of a Boundary that was hungry for enemies!
In this path, he wouldn't even have to think about possibly using his prize of the reserves of the True Authority of Quintessence on anything other than himself.
On anything other than what he wanted to use it on- his Boundaries!
"Good..let's do it this way!"
HUUM!
His body buzzed as he maintained the state of Resonance and gazed at the vastness of the Prana Dimension, but he didn't act to use the authority of this Era to remove the Anchor.
The Source of Reality that was expectantly waiting for this buzzed to voice its concern even though it knew that it did not make a mistake to continue allowing this being to retain control!
So why...

"My clones shall personally go to devour and assimilate the Dimensions with only Ancestral Descendants. The 3 chances of Displacement will be utilized for the Dimensions where Desiderius and the Ancestral Descendants Commanders are located...so Niflheim, Elysium, and Quantum Dimensions shall be last!"
A golden path opened up.
<I Am the Main Character> didn't even have to activate to tell Noah to follow this path!
The Boundary of LOOT pushed for it and sought more as once Noah made this decision, he began to spur his Clones to move while freely doing something he held back on because of the uncertainties.
He ushered towards the True Throne of Quintessence as his Main Body returned to it, the prize for the Age of Quintessence finally having a direction to be taken to!
As Noah did this, the Source of Reality calculatingly observed his actions and the change in the sequence of events as its Will emanated out.
<<I will share what I have learned about the Boundaries from the Sealers that have descended over the Ages, and why they left behind their very Laws of Nature for them.>>
WAA!
Boundaries!
The Will of Reality saw the direction Noah was going as it proactively shared information!
Noah sat on the True Throne of Quintessence while beginning to use it as a key, listening closely at such a critical juncture.

<<Each Boundary is different, and they are designated into different tiers depending on their power, utility, and ease towards EXTREMITY among other factors. Any concept can be taken to EXTREMITY as even Natural Laws could be expanded into Boundaries that seek EXTREMITY. Yet the Natural Laws that make up the fabric of Reality are considered at the extreme lowest tier in the ranking of Sealers due to their nature of needing integration and to be bound by existences, imposing their boundaries upon them as the other reason for them to rank at the lowest possible tier is their extreme difficulty towards EXTREMITY.>>

<<One could have crossed 10 Boundary Layers towards EXTREMITY with other Concepts after years worth of work or the utilization of rare treasures, but if the same was applied to a Boundary of Manadynamics- only a single Boundary Layer would have been crossed.>>

Shocking information about the True nature of this flowed out as Noah looked at his Boundary of LOOT that he had only crossed 2 Boundary Layers towards EXTREMITY as this took the authority of an Era expanding it!
Yet if one tried to expand the limitations of Natural Laws and take them towards Extremity..the difficulty was hundreds of times more.
This was because after passing every Boundary Layer, exceeding the next one was many times harder!

So when Ancestors came across Boundaries and saw how they were bound by Natural Laws along with their high difficulty in making any progress paired up with the heavy losses from their enemies..they could only make the choice to suppress these laws and stop their effect on them.

<<Due to insufficient information, we cannot classify what the Bloodline Boundary of the VOID is considered, nor how it compares to the Boundary of LOOT you have forged. Normally, the Tier of a Boundary cannot be changed. But if you truly do enact the Boundary of QUINTESSENCE, there might be a chance for you to change this due to the nature of such a Boundary. And of course, you have a vastly different understanding of Natural Laws as you were not bound by them like the Sealers. If you do expand any of the Natural Laws towards EXTREMITY, your experience may be entirely different compared to the Sealers who designated them as the worst concepts to expand towards EXTREMITY.>>
BOOM!
A cluster of truly fantastical information came as Noah's mind illuminated greatly.
Boundless possibilities bloomed from this as the Will of Reality didn't need to say anymore!
Noah acted right away as he came upon a moment of truth that other True Emperors also came across Ages past.
The utilization of the Authority of an Age that they lorded over.
The True Emperor of Destiny had split apart Reality.
The True Emperor of Quintessence...
His devilishly handsome face developed a smile full of confidence and ingenuity as while seated on the multicolored throne, his crown released waves of austere light as his command surged forth.
"Let the glorious True Authority of Quintessence flow."
HUUUM!
"Let them take the path of QUINTESSENCE and LOOT towards Extremity!"
He knew not what their Tiers would be.
He didn't even know how to look at their comparators!
He only knew...his Boundaries were going to be something that nobody else could fathom!

A new path to take!
The Boundary of LOOT was like an impatient child sending its thoughts to Noah and saying this was the best way to do it.
And Noah was altering his mind and plans on this new path already.

The 3 chances of Displacement..he altered his mind to shift them to the Dimensions that had Ancestral Descendant Commanders, NOBLESSE, and the Quantum Dimension as the last one as if he did it this way, he may not even have to clash with the most powerful enemies before he completely removed the shackles of the Desolate Mausoleum and assimilated all Dimensions!
HOOONG!
Only now did Providence and Destiny begin to buzz wildly.
In his unique state of Resonance, Noah smiled devilishly as he enacted a new path with the lead of a Boundary that was hungry for enemies!
In this path, he wouldn't even have to think about possibly using his prize of the reserves of the True Authority of Quintessence on anything other than himself.
On anything other than what he wanted to use it on- his Boundaries!
"Good..let's do it this way!"
HUUM!
His body buzzed as he maintained the state of Resonance and gazed at the vastness of the Prana Dimension, but he didn't act to use the authority of this Era to remove the Anchor.
The Source of Reality that was expectantly waiting for this buzzed to voice its concern even though it knew that it did not make a mistake to continue allowing this being to retain control!
So why...
"My clones shall personally go to devour and assimilate the Dimensions with only Ancestral Descendants.
The 3 chances of Displacement will be utilized for the Dimensions where Desiderius and the Ancestral Descendants Commanders are located...so Niflheim, Elysium, and Quantum Dimensions shall be last!"
A golden path opened up.
<I Am the Main Character> didn't even have to activate to tell Noah to follow this path!
The Boundary of LOOT pushed for it and sought more as once Noah made this decision, he began to spur his Clones to move while freely doing something he held back on because of the uncertainties.
He ushered towards the True Throne of Quintessence as his Main Body returned to it, the prize for the Age of Quintessence finally having a direction to be taken to!
As Noah did this, the Source of Reality calculatingly observed his actions and the change in the sequence of events as its Will emanated out.
<<I will share what I have learned about the Boundaries from the Sealers that have descended over the Ages, and why they left behind their very Laws of Nature for them.>>
WAA!
Boundaries!
The Will of Reality saw the direction Noah was going as it proactively shared information!
Noah sat on the True Throne of Quintessence while beginning to use it as a key, listening closely at such a critical juncture.
<<Each Boundary is different, and they are designated into different tiers depending on their power, utility, and ease towards EXTREMITY among other factors.
Any concept can be taken to EXTREMITY as even Natural Laws could be expanded into Boundaries that seek EXTREMITY.

Yet the Natural Laws that make up the fabric of Reality are considered at the extreme lowest tier in the ranking of Sealers due to their nature of needing integration and to be bound by existences, imposing their boundaries upon them as the other reason for them to rank at the lowest possible tier is their extreme difficulty towards EXTREMITY.>>

<<One could have crossed 10 Boundary Layers towards EXTREMITY with other Concepts after years worth of work or the utilization of rare treasures, but if the same was applied to a Boundary of Manadynamics- only a single Boundary Layer would have been crossed.>>

Shocking information about the True nature of this flowed out as Noah looked at his Boundary of LOOT that he had only crossed 2 Boundary Layers towards EXTREMITY as this took the authority of an Era expanding it!
Yet if one tried to expand the limitations of Natural Laws and take them towards Extremity..the difficulty was hundreds of times more.
This was because after passing every Boundary Layer, exceeding the next one was many times harder!

So when Ancestors came across Boundaries and saw how they were bound by Natural Laws along with their high difficulty in making any progress paired up with the heavy losses from their enemies..they could only make the choice to suppress these laws and stop their effect on them.
<<Due to insufficient information, we cannot classify what the Bloodline Boundary of the VOID is considered, nor how it compares to the Boundary of LOOT you have forged.
Normally, the Tier of a Boundary cannot be changed.
But if you truly do enact the Boundary of QUINTESSENCE, there might be a chance for you to change this due to the nature of such a Boundary.
And of course, you have a vastly different understanding of Natural Laws as you were not bound by them like the Sealers.
If you do expand any of the Natural Laws towards EXTREMITY, your experience may be entirely different compared to the Sealers who designated them as the worst concepts to expand towards EXTREMITY.>>
BOOM!
A cluster of truly fantastical information came as Noah's mind illuminated greatly.
Boundless possibilities bloomed from this as the Will of Reality didn't need to say anymore!
Noah acted right away as he came upon a moment of truth that other True Emperors also came across Ages past.
The utilization of the Authority of an Age that they lorded over.
The True Emperor of Destiny had split apart Reality.
The True Emperor of Quintessence...
His devilishly handsome face developed a smile full of confidence and ingenuity as while seated on the multicolored throne, his crown released waves of austere light as his command surged forth.
"Let the glorious True Authority of Quintessence flow."
HUUUM!

chapters.title: Chapter 2199 Utter Desecration Of Logic! II
paragraphs: 2199 Utter Desecration of Logic! II
Within what could be considered the center of the very Barren Lands.
Within the Source of Reality..multicolored radiance overflowed as the True Emperor of this Age utilized his authority!
And it went towards establishing a fantastical Boundary while also elevating an already existing one, Noah monitoring the changes in real time as he felt the cycles of changes.

Normally, one would be relying on their Aeonic Soul Power to illuminate the path forward towards EXTREMITY, with geniuses exceeding their Boundary Layers upon receiving epiphanies or the usage of unfathomable treasures outside the Barren Lands.

The only Treasure within the Barren Lands that had the effect of expanding Boundaries was exactly the True Throne that cycled over the Ages- and most of the True Emperors utilized their authority to expand their Boundary!
True Empress Katya had the Boundary of KARMA, while True Emperor Hideyoshi had the Boundary of FATE.
Now, Noah observed the intricate expansion of the concepts of QUINTESSENCE and LOOT!
All of this was to measure up to the most powerful Ancestral Descendants and achieve the freedom of the Desolate Mausoleum.

And while this process was ongoing, Pure Quintessential Kainos Natural Decretum Seeds burned as all newly learned Laws went towards completion, especially the Fundamental Natural Laws of Continuity and Isochronism that Noah wanted to be among those he could half bind their Source as the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality swallowed more and more Realities into itself!
The millions of Shards of NULLITY and Pearls of NULLITY that were received after being Decuplicated also burned furiously as Noah's understanding of NULLITY scaled upwards.
Preparations were in full bloom by the True Emperor of Quintessence at this moment!

He had withstood a single Aeonic Damage Value in the Apollyon Dimension from a single Ancestral Descendant over the past day- and this had been a point of surprise for that being as they began to release even more ferocious attacks.

But now, his many advancements in concepts that granted increased multipliers as well as the forging of his Dimensional Layers...it all allowed him to release Aeonic Damage Values exceeding 100 even without putting his Body into account!

This 100 Aeonic Damage Value should be a threshold for the common Ancestral Descendants as after Noah completed all the recent elevations, he expected to be heading towards 200 Aeonic Damage Values and higher.
At such a juncture, he would place the common Ancestral Descendants below his feet.
"Good..."
BZZZT!
His Will vibrated joyously as he felt a limitation crack at this moment.
The True Authority of Quintessence was surging out like stellar seas into his body as they wrapped around his soul and elevated it even further!
Noah felt his limitations exceeded as a Boundary Layer was exceeded and soon after..another Boundary was also initiated!
Noah felt his Soul cry out with joy at this moment as uniquely, he felt streams of authority bathe it and elevate it even higher.
This..was a power that came when one went further towards EXTREMITY.
It was the elevation of one's soul on this path as it seemed Noah had passed a critical junction in his Boundary to achieve it!
His Will scrutinized the new changes as he became alarmed at the grandiosity before him.
<The Boundary of LOOT has reached the Third Boundary Layer through the True Authority of Quintessence!>
<The Boundary of QUINTESSENCE has reached the First Boundary Layer through the True Authority of Quintessence!>
<Through the effect of the First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE, the Boundary of Loot has reached the Fourth Boundary Layer!>
"What!"
Noah's mind buzzed as he felt an explosion of regality within his soul.
The Boundary of QUINTESSENCE seemed to be utterly ridiculous as Noah had to verify its effect right away, his Will surging into it speedily!

<The First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE> (Passive): A terrifying concept to be forged into a Boundary as its path towards EXTREMITY is to always seek to be the most ideal and perfect example of a Boundary. Its Tier among Boundaries is not fixed as it can change the further it goes towards Extremity. The First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE is a simple one as it seeks to make the Boundaries of its Master unequaled, directly increasing all your current Boundaries one additional Boundary Layer. This passive effect is only applicable to a concept that has already become a Boundary, and this effect is not applicable to the Boundary of QUINTESSENCE itself...
Noah stared at the boons of the First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE in utter surprise due to its sheer effects.
It was a complete destruction of Reality and logic.

An utter desecration of what everyone knew as if the Ancestral Descendants knew such a thing existed..they would question what their hard work for billions of years was for in order to raise just one concept to the Third Boundary Layer, or multiple aspects to the Second Boundary Layer!
Yes.
Billions of years! This was how long it took to raise a single Boundary to the Third Layer, or the Fourth Boundary Layer if one was a genius!
And this number could only be reduced or changed with Treasures that affected Boundaries- which could achieve new Layers instantly after their Absorption or a few years after.
But for Noah..as long as he made any concept into a Boundary, it would instantly be elevated by another Boundary Layer!
It was simply terrifying.
His soul was experiencing the boons of this as it seemed other benchmarks were met with the Boundary of LOOT.

<The Third Boundary Layer of LOOT >(Passive):: The Layer that shall be known as The Glory of LOOT has appeared. The passage of this Boundary is a critical juncture as it elevates your strength, allowing the Authority of LOOT to constantly refine and strengthen your Soul over time as another critical feature is the augmentation of +100% to All Aeonic Parameter Values. This percentage augmentation will change over time as it is dependent on how much glorious Loot you attain from this point onward, where the higher quality and quantity of Loot you attain, the greater the Augmentation Value...
Speechless.
Noah was utterly speechless.
