chapters.title: Chapter 2200 Utter Desecration Of Logic! III
paragraphs: 2200 Utter Desecration of Logic! III
Noah was utterly speechless as the Boundary of LOOT was truly living up to its name!
The more Loot he collected from now and to the end of his lifetime..it would all go towards making him stronger!
And the value to pay attention to here was the +100% to All Aeonic Parameter Values.
Aeonic!

There was the All True Parameter Values Augmentation that concepts like NULLITY granted. Now, there came the Augmentation for All Aeonic Parameter Values as his Aeonic Soul Value that was being elevated this whole time and grew from 225 to 300..it had doubled as this was the reason that Noah felt the surging changes to his soul!
An Aeonic Soul Value of 600.
From less than 100 not too long ago before he completed his Dimensional Realities!
His actions only further expressed his pace of progression and how ridiculous it was compared to others.
The higher this value was, the stronger his other Aspects of Existence became and the faster his ability to take concepts towards EXTREMITY became.
Strength begets strength. Power begets power. It was a fantastical cycle that Noah would follow to its very end!

Apart from the Aeonic Soul Value, his Aeonic Damage Value was also affected by this +100% to All Aeonic Parameter Values Augmentation, where his range of approximately 140-160 Aeonic Damage Values he could currently release from skills effectively doubled.
This was Glory.
This was Quintessence!
But even this was not all!
HOONG!
His body buzzed as if it was a Celestial metal being reforged for the quintillionth time.
He had the Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation that made his body and soul robust.
It granted 100 Aeonic Values of Damage and Defense for his body alone and a Value of 25 for the Soul- all without any resource cost and purely on their strength alone!

As he sat on the True Throne of Quintessence, his musculature became even more magisterial as it felt like empyral crystalline metalloids made up his bones and tissues, these Values also being affected by the Third Boundary Layer of LOOT as they doubled.
His Body alone could release 200 Aeonic Damage Values with a wave of his hands.
This..was a glimpse of why Boundaries were favored so much.

Compared to the concepts of Natural Laws that were so hard to raise towards EXTREMITY that one couldn't reach the Third Boundary Layer for MANADYNAMICS or any similar Fundamental Natural Law for countless billions of years..why wouldn't they be left behind for Boundaries that were more manageable?!

Noah felt the torrential waves of multicolored tendrils swirling around his body as his eyes shone with eagerness when gazing at the Fourth Boundary Layer of Loot that was unlocked purely because of the First Boundary Layer of QUINTESSENCE.

<The Fourth Boundary Layer of LOOT >(Passive):: Why must you focus on a single enemy when seeking Loot? This Layer seeks for the True Emperor of Quintessence to attain Loot all around him as it makes way for Passive Loot Absorption. At absolutely no cost to you, any being designated as an enemy in your immediate surroundings will begin to have their Aspects of Existence, Life Force, Concepts, and anything else that makes their being drained by you as quintessential loot. This passive ability is capable of draining enemies at one-tenth the speed of Active Loot Absorption, with weaker enemies that cannot withstand your Maximum Aeonic Output not noticing this process until it is too late and stronger targets having greater resistance as they will have to rely on their Boundaries to prevent everything about them being turned into Loot.
A glorious Fourth Boundary Layer!

Noah had gained a single target Active Loot Absorption from the Second Boundary Layer, and he now attained an area of effect Passive Loot Absorption for the Fourth Boundary Layer at absolutely no cost to him.
Those who were unlucky enough to decide to be his enemies would be turned into Loot the moment they were near him.
There was only one part of this Boundary that Noah didn't like.
The "Immediate surroundings’ that this ability effectively worked on! It was vague as Noah himself would have to see just how far it could apply its ridiculous effects!

But with this recent expansion of Boundary Layers- especially the effects of the Third Boundary Layer of LOOT, Noah felt ready to begin tackling Ancestral Descendants and the assimilation of Dimensions.

Even though there were still many aspects of him that were still in the process of elevating and others like the assimilation of the ZENITH Bloodlines he had yet to begin, he felt prepared enough to begin!
HUUM!
A low symphony of a rousing battle began to build up as his Will moved.
His Main Body would remain near the Source of Reality as there was still much to be done, but his clones and even his Vassals..he would put them to use!
His voice emanated out to those pertinent as Noah began to mobilize his forces for the final war of the Barren Lands.
"Let's put you all on the front lines...even if your task is going to be as distractions!"

Guinevere, Morgana, Albus, Lilith ..all those that received the False Epochal Blades of Quintessence and had taken this time to at least master the roots of the [Blood Lord] skill tree that began to path of True Sanguine Clones- all of them were ushered to move their newly enacted clones en masse as their heads rose.

Within the Mirror Dimension, The Great Usurper was shown a path towards the Prana Dimension with his False Epochal Blade of Quintessence as he and his Undead Legions began to move- his Will turning away from the fluctuations of battles occurring from afar where his soul felt a calling.
A calling of death that he didn't fully know about at this moment as it was the Boundary of DEATH!
ROAR!

The Draconian body of the Dimensional Hellion Ruler he subjugated roared out with power as it entered the folds of space, the allure of an EPOCH Relic leading the way as the True Emperor of Quintessence made the inhabitants of the Barren Lands put in the work to save their homes!

chapters.title: Chapter 2201 2201 Just Who Is The Ancestor Here? I
paragraphs: 2201 Just Who is the Ancestor Here? I
Immense panic and despair!

This was the state of the upper echelons of Primordials as their Primordial Temples had shattered with the realization that they had labeled the Emperor of the current Age as an Enemy, and not too long after..the Primordial Seers with proficiency in Destiny and Providence felt their very eyes burn as they were led to a terrifying truth!
The truth that the life lines and destinies of the Tribunal Rulers were no longer present!
The implications for this were utterly horrendous as what was worse was that they couldn't readily spread this information with the blanket of the VOID.
All beings panicked when the VOID descended and placed them in an age of darkness, but the Seers despaired when they faced the truth of the very pillars of their Lineage disappearing.
Some Primordials though..were stuck on a forked path that they did not know how to traverse.
Within the Main Reality.

Akaris and Juliette happened to be together when the VOID descended as they remained close, their eyes still stuck on the visage of the True Emperor of Quintessence sitting grandly on a throne as he seemed to be the only source of light in this darkness!

They saw his words that those who wished for salvation should pledge fealty to his cause and join him as when they saw the image of the existence upon the Throne... the face they saw was one they were familiar with!
Juliette spoke at this moment as she shook her head while her fingers twirled with tendrils of Destiny.
"I would say we were being played by him before, but it seems he could have eradicated us whenever he wanted. What are you going to do?"
She asked the SHIELD OF DAWN that was bathed in golden radiance what path they would take.
They knew their own Lineage and loyalties.
And they also grasped Destiny.
At this juncture, their Destiny told them this being they saw upon the Throne..was the only golden path left for them as anything towards their Lineage was bleak!
The eyes of Akaris flashed with sharpness as her sword and shield pulsed, turning towards Juliette as her eyes seemed to have already made their choice!
Within the Boundary Between Realities.

Theseus was now wading across this stretch of space while the sword he held out before him pulsed- each pulse releasing a wave of light that spread out to cover any nearby Realities and vast regions of space with his Will briefly as he searched!
He was seeking the direction of the existence he was sent down here to erase as for him, this was his only mission.

Others knew him as the terrifying Commander who even exceeded True Emperors of recent Ages who had utilized the Authority of their Age to expand a Boundary, but he had an even more unique identity than that.
An identity that only the truly powerful knew!
The term Ancestral Descendant was given out to recent generations of existences in the last trillions of years, and even he was also a descendant.

But he..was the most recent descendant of the Ancestor that had enacted the <Boundary of the Sword>, and he was carried on the belly of another Ancestor that had exceeded many Boundary Layers on this same path!
He lived and breathed the Sword before he was even born.
Not too long after he was born, he began to seek the First Layer of the Sword.
Now, many years later..he had achieved results that even his father couldn't help but nod at with pride, expectant of the achievements as his identity was kept a secret even now.
After all, any direct descendants of the Ancestors were among those with the highest mortality rates due to the cruelty and schemes of the NOBLESSE!
So his genius..was very much watered down.
Nobody truth knew a speck about what he could truly do!

As his sword continued to hum, Theseus entered a trance at this juncture as his whole body came to a stop, a blazing illusion of a dazzling white sword rising with him at the center and piercing its sword tip above as it shockingly tore apart the VOID- this area becoming as clear as day.
HUUUM!
In this state of Resonance, Theseus finally felt something.
Something deeply veiled in the folds of the very fabric of Reality itself as even existences who had achieved the Third or Fourth Boundary of a path would not be able to sense!
He could see..flashes of light hidden by Reality itself surging towards a certain direction.

He soon identified these flashes of light to be dazzlingstellar rivers of Reality- rivers that were currentlybathed with the golden Authority of Dreams among amyriad of other authorities as they actually movedacross the spacetime continuum silently to headtowards a singular direction!
BUZZ!
The Sword in the hands of Theseus buzzed with wildness as it provided him with boundless information and feedback.
His exceedingly handsome and sharp features retained their calm as while sensing the directions of these flashing rivers of Reality, Theseus moved towards the same direction they surged in!
Far from the moving figure of Theseus, across the folds of Reality and Dimensions.
Within the Prana Dimension.

The Dimension full of life and vibrancy had dimmed ever slightly after the VOID had descended, and in the nearby surroundings where 16 Ancestral Descendants were clustered...it was even dimmer as the Boundary of DEATH permeated in waves from them!

Serafina led this squadron in place of Commander Yvonne in the Prana Dimension, her hair being stained as dark as the surrounding space while hiding her beautiful visage, three terrifyingly massive Gehenna Aeonic Undead Daemons surrounding her as they gave off terrifying waves of power whole occasionally releasing blasts of NULLITY that increased the ruptures across this Dimension.

The Ancestral Descendant behind her had varieties of Aeonic Undead summoned as some had vast Legions surrounding them, while others had a few truly strong Aeonic Undead like Serafina while they sought to complete their mission in this Dimension.
A mission to watch it perish and prevent the risen True Emperor from the information they were provided- to prevent this being from acting to remove this Anchor that they currently oversaw!

Immense panic and despair!

The truth that the life lines and destinies of the Tribunal Rulers were no longer present!
The implications for this were utterly horrendous as what was worse was that they couldn't readily spread this information with the blanket of the VOID.
All beings panicked when the VOID descended and placed them in an age of darkness, but the Seers despaired when they faced the truth of the very pillars of their Lineage disappearing.
Some Primordials though..were stuck on a forked path that they did not know how to traverse.
Within the Main Reality.

"I would say we were being played by him before, but it seems he could have eradicated us whenever he wanted.

chapters.title: Chapter 2202 2202 Just Who Is The Ancestor Here? II
paragraphs: 2202 Just Who is the Ancestor Here? II

In the expanse of the VOID, Serafina waded through it with 15 other Ancestral Descendants as they monitored the state of destruction of this Dimension, their Aeonic Undead continuing to release bursts of NULLITY every now and then to increase the pace of progression while waiting for the unknown enemy in the dark!
And..they did not have to wait long.
'Hmm?
Serafina's eyes shone sharply as the Boundary of Death pulled her senses towards something new.
Something that stepped out of the folds of Reality as a dazzling crimson gold sword led the way forward!
A sword that when Serafina and the other Descendants squinted, they saw a half-moon crescent disk attached behind it as it released waves of power.

The being to step out of it was a massive silver black Dragon- a past Dimensional Hellion Ruler who was known as the Mirror of Death and someone that all Descendants recognized from the memories shared by CHARLEMAGNE to prepare them for all the beings with a level of importance in the Barren Lands.
Among the information that the Rulers of the Quantum Dimension shared, the names and identities of other Rulers were the basics!

Serafina's eyes released a powerful light as she scrutinized the appearance of this Mirror of Death that she considered far beneath her, his surroundings becoming filled with the aura of death as Legions of Undead appeared with him.
Undead that caused Serafina to sneer in distaste as she spoke out with regality.
"I have seen death. What you show before us...is barely a cusp of death!"

Serafina spoke coldly as the Gehenna Aeonic Undead Daemons around her growled, their eyes only carefully gazing at the radiant sword chained to a half disk that released waves of EPOCH around this being!
But apart from this, the measly Undead Legions were nothing to worry about.
But it was at this juncture when...
SHAA! SHAA!
Multiple foldings in space ruptured out as more and more figures appeared near them.
A devilishly beautiful demon Empress with cold and emotionless eyes.
An enchanting Empress adorned in a purple battledress and shining with regal coldness.
An old man with a verdant head of hair and beard as he seemed filled with ancientness!
A golden haired girl shining with valiance and power!

The figures of Lilith, Guinevere, Albus, Eowyn, The Longest Dream and all the rest that were granted the False Epochal Blades of Quintessence appeared with their clones one after another as they faced the terrifying grandeur of Ancestral Descendants.
Each of them were equipped with an EPOCH Relic that granted tremendous boosts as they wanted to see if this was enough to bridge an unreachable gap!

Yet Serafina and the other Ancestral Descendants gazed at them with extremely coldness and apathy as a Descendant with Obsidian wings of deathly light behind his back stepped close to Serafina's domain while gazing at all the new entrants, his eyes pointing each of them out as he released oppressive waves of the light of a Boundary.

"The Hellion Ruler Lilith, the Oldest Tree Albus, Guinevere..all of you were left to be leading figures of your Dimensions by the Will of the Ancestors and what your own Lineages pleaded for. You would now turn your back so stupidly? What can you even hope to accomplish against the power we wield?!"
WAA!

The newly appearing figures of Rulers were recognized from the information these beings were provided as let's not forget- all of them were connected in one way or another as the Lineages ruling over Dimensions extended to the Ancestors and Ancestral Descendants outside the Barren Lands!
To rebel against them was an impossibility, and all Rulers were expected to fall in line.
Yet...
<Let's not be too hasty to decide what the winning side will be.>
Eowyn's voice emanated out with grandiosity as she grasped the False Epochal Blade of Quintessence in her hands tightly.
The past her may have agreed with them had she not met Noah.
Had she not observed what a ridiculous reality this being could forge!
Yet towards her words...
"Who even are you, child? To speak so arrogantly towards your Ancestors?"

Cold and demeaning words filled with power echoed out from Serafina as among the information they were given, Rulers like Eowyn who were considered Dead through the hands of OPPENHEIMER and absent over the past Age were not included even though she made a brief appearance in the Dimensional Conclave!
The attitude the Ancestral Descendants had towards those they saw before them was extremely clear as even to this, none of the followers of the True Emperor of Quintessence faltered!

Eowyn's Clone even smiled brightly as her soul power bloomed into the False Epochal Blade of Quintessence, choosing to make the first move even though she knew she stood no chance against the beings before her.
<Who am I? I'm someone who will at least live longer than you in the future to comel!>
WAA!
The 10 False Epochal Blades of Quintessence blared like loud horns as they released epochal waves of grandiosity, a brutal battle beginning.

While Eowyn and the others did this, the Avalon, Dream, and Prana Dimensional Chassis appeared in another corner of the Prana Dimension as the verdant clone of Noah took out the Pocket Dimensional Reality and anchored it in space.
The forces he had sent towards the Ancestral Descendants were merely that.
A Distraction!

A distraction while he began to swallow up this Dimension silently without their senses catching anything until it was too late- and Noah could step in even at this juncture to ensure the success of the devouring of this Dimension and its assimilation!
And this was him moving with an extra level of care.
HOONG!

He observed the fast rate of Absorption of the surrounding space as with the aid of Albus and quite literally the apocalyptic state of Reality currently, it didn't take much to have the Source of Prana make the choice of assimilation as the rate of this process was even much faster than before!
He watched the stellar green radiance being devoured with a smile as his inquisitive eyes turned to gaze towards the far distance.
His eyes were bathed with the Boundary of LOOT and QUINTESSENCE at the Fourth and First Boundary Layers respectively as wondrously..he could see past the blanket of the VOID as clear as day.
Against the Boundary of the VOID laid down by a NOBLESSE..Noah could see through it with ease when utilizing the Authority of his own Boundaries!
With such a power that wasn't fully measured at this moment, he stared at the faraway figures of Ancestral Descendants that had begun to thrash his people.
He stared at them as a devilish smile formed over his clones' faces, seeing their arrogant and prideful demeanor that was just asking to be fucked up!

chapters.title: Chapter 2203 Just Who is the Ancestor Here?! III
paragraphs: Weaklings that could barely keep up against her Gehenna Aeonic Undead Daemons!
This was what Serafina saw when she observed the 10 Nature Integration existences that each had the support of an EPOCH Relic.
This in itself was a cause for concern as no beings in the Desolate Mausoleum should have such Relics- much less 10 identical ones.
But that was it.
That was the extent of concern that was risen as these beings...

"Only a little stronger than expected for those still remaining here and bound by Natural Laws. Leave this foolish endeavor behind and ask for mercy..and you shall be allowed to join the ranks of your predecessors."
The contempt could be felt from Serafina's words the intense black waves of the Boundary of Death calmly swirled around her.
BOOM!

She saw the same scene occur as before- where the massive verdant gold body of an ancient tree that nearly rivaled Yggdrasil received attacks from an Aeonic Undead as the EPOCH Relic took in the brunt of the attack, dissipating much of the tens of Aeonic Damage Values before they smashed into Albus and knocked his figure further back!
And this was all that happened with all of them.
Being placed in defensive positions as after a few more seconds of attacks and pressure from the Aeonic Undead of the Ancestral Descendants..these beings were bound to fall.

The figure of Lilith bound by the Will of another gritted her teeth as she felt the discrepancy in power, affirming once more how it would have been impossible for them to stand against these beings had things played out as they planned.
The visage of the Great Usurper was even more solemn as he had considered himself someone of great power and destiny, and yet even he was in the same situation!
But the clones of the holders of the False Epochal Blades of Quintessence were not put down by the large gulf in power as they fought even more freely and with fervor.
They wanted to see the extent of their limits as they could at least be content that they had done their task!
Their task of only keeping these beings busy.

And it seemed they weren't the only ones to affirm this as Serafina scrutinized her eyes at this moment while looking at their eyes blazing with battle intent, the Boundary of Death swirling in her mind and pulsing with information as she saw the discrepancy of these beings that were fighting as if it was to throw their lives away!
She expanded her senses.
Billowing waves of darkness stretched out across the immediate VOID as instantly, she became astounded.
When she spread the authority of her Boundary, she could feel the very fabric of Reality of this Dimension becoming twisted and seemingly pulled towards another location!
It was exactly what they were warned about!
BOOOM!
Anger appeared in her eyes as her power exploded out along with her voice.
"They are only distractions, the one displacing Dimensions is already here!"
Her words instantly roused everyone as their authorities instantly blared out.
Serafina felt played and frustrated as she continued to spread her Boundary out, blasting away the figures of Eowyn and Guinevere from the eruption of her maddening power!
They had to locate the one responsible for the Displacement of Dimensions and-
"I am here."
HUUUM!
A magnetic voice emanated out that caused her eyes to flutter.
All the Ancestral Descendants here stood to attention as they felt billowing waves of power in this voice.
Serafina's expanded senses very quickly caught onto it as she saw..him.

The visage of a being wrapped with a light of mystery and power as a verdant light of life surrounded him, his figure appearing in the direction the body of Eowyn was thrown to as he held her frustrated yet injured figure in his hands with a smile!
Atop his head, a dazzling crown was adorned as his identity was freely displayed for all to see.
The instant he appeared...
BZZZT!
The Authority of a Boundary blared to life maddeningly around the Ancestral Descendants as they began to leak out with extreme power.

The Automaton Boundary Modulators around them swallowed and released waves of essence along with them as these beings had become utterly serious, with Serafina's eyes shaking as she and all the others felt..an aura akin to their Commander from this being!
An unfathomable aura that seemed contained and yet wild- an Aura that was similar to Commander Yvonne!

All of the pride and arrogance in their eyes disappeared as millions of years of wading across battlefields with their lives on the line were pulled forward, the mere aura of this being alone making them feel as if they were back on the bloody battlefields outside these Barren Lands.
That they had returned...to the Vaults of Extremity!
To the Havens of Extremity!
To the Lands of Extremity!
Different beings in this space called the vast and endless domains different names, with the mystery and danger of these Lands unfathomable to this day.
Most regions had pervasive seas of NULLITY that made it hard for those who were weak to even survive, other regions had the same tier of terrifying concepts if not even grander pervading across them.

When the Ancestors ascended into these dangerous lands, they termed them the Vaults of Extremity due to the boundless treasures they hid within them and their utilization to take one towards EXTREMITY.
Chaoticus Beasts were the least of the dangers.
The NOBLESSE were powerful and unfathomable as they reigned across countless domains, and they were the most immediate danger!
But many more dangers existed.

Because the Vaults of Extremity connected all the myriad Aspects of Reality. All the countless incalculable Planes of Existence and their own parallel possibilities! The Planes of Existence contained in the Barren Lands and their inhabitants who ascended into these dangerous lands were only a fraction of what could be seen in the Havens of Extremity!

At this juncture, the aura of a single being made Serafina and the other Ancestral Descendants feel like they had met one of the countless unpredictable dangers one could meet when just wading through the Vaults of Extremity!

All of the pride and arrogance in their eyes disappeared as millions of years of wading across battlefields with their lives on the line were pulled forward, the mere aura of this being alone making them feel as if they were back on the bloody battlefields outside these Barren Lands.
That they had returned...to the Vaults of Extremity!
To the Havens of Extremity!
To the Lands of Extremity!
Different beings in this space called the vast and endless domains different names, with the mystery and danger of these Lands unfathomable to this day.
Most regions had pervasive seas of NULLITY that made it hard for those who were weak to even survive, other regions had the same tier of terrifying concepts if not even grander pervading across them.

When the Ancestors ascended into these dangerous lands, they termed them the Vaults of Extremity due to the boundless treasures they hid within them and their utilization to take one towards EXTREMITY.
Chaoticus Beasts were the least of the dangers.
The NOBLESSE were powerful and unfathomable as they reigned across countless domains, and they were the most immediate danger!
But many more dangers existed.
Because the Vaults of Extremity connected all the myriad Aspects of Reality.
All the countless incalculable Planes of Existence and their own parallel possibilities!
The Planes of Existence contained in the Barren Lands and their inhabitants who ascended into these dangerous lands were only a fraction of what could be seen in the Havens of Extremity!

At this juncture, the aura of a single being made Serafina and the other Ancestral Descendants feel like they had met one of the countless unpredictable dangers one could meet when just wading through the Vaults of Extremity!

chapters.title: Chapter 2204 Just Who is the Ancestor Here?! IV
paragraphs: A feeling of danger as if they had returned to the deadly Havens of Extremity!
That was what this being emanated as these battle hardened Ancestral Descendants instantly utilized powerful waves of their authority.

Serafina's face scrunched and lost some of its beauty as the Authority of the Boundary of Death amalgamated around her, her dreary voice filled with darkness booming out and not even giving this new entrant a chance to exert himself!
"Release all of your Second Boundary Layers, do not hold back!"
Her resonant voice gave out a command as her Aeonic Soul then paid the price to activate something fantastical.
<Tower of Death!>
HUUM!
Multiple voices repeated such words.
Power exceeding the First Boundary Layer of Death erupted out from 16 Ancestral Descendants.

The second layer of the Boundary of Death..allowed one to use the Authority of this Boundary in an offensive and defensive manner that brought one's enemies to death if they couldn't defend against its authority!
And now, Serafina had urged all those around her to blanket and focus all of the authority of this Layer onto this single being.

Immense Obsidian waves of darkness rushed forward and formed into tall obsidian Towers of Death- towers that turned this whole area into a domain of this Boundary as the majestic constructs then released tendrils of darkness to torrentially surge towards the True Emperor of Quintessence and drown him out of existence!
Tendrils that no doubt exceeded 100 Aeonic Damage Values in power as they came from 16 different sources.
But in response to all this...
HOONG!
A high paced crescendo of a melody began to ring out at a fast pace.
Instead of his figure being devoured by the waves of deathly darkness from Towers of the 16 Ancestral Descendants, a dazzling halcyon glow erupted from his body domineeringly.

A vibrant glow of gold that seemed like a rising sun coming to meet a blanket of nothingness as it incredulously..burned the Authority of the Boundary of Death as the tendrils of darkness emanating from the towers were scorched out of existence.
Burned by the halcyon light into nothingness before it could even near the True Emperor of Quintessence!
"Ahh."

The rays of golden light seemed scalding to look at as they didn't just affect the torrential waves of the Boundary of Death, they actually caused the VOID in the surroundings to even retreat- causing a scene that made Serafina dumbfounded!
This was because seeing such a vibrant light of a Boundary reminded her of the regal NOBLESSE Commanders who she feared when she stared at from afar during the truly brutal wars.
Yet he couldn't be NOBLESSE as his Boundary Authority was pushing away the VOID...right?
But even this was terrifying in itself as the other option meant this being was releasing a light of a Boundary that could repulse even the VOID of the Noblesse.
And such a terrifying being didn't give them a chance to even think as he floated forward like a dazzling sun, his eyes full of Tyranny!
Power.
Noah once more felt its allure as he felt just his entrance dominate the battlefield against beings that a day ago, he would have lost against.
But that was a day ago when he couldn't dish out even a single Aeonic Damage Value.
Now, he could absorb 200 with his body alone and release the same amount with his mere fingers!
He didn't fall too deep into the allure of power as he observed a fantastical scene the moment that he arrived here.

It was the budding of cylindrical golden pathways that held the grandeur of Loot passing through them like stars- all of these pathways connected to the 16 Ancestral Descendants as <Passive Loot Absorption> had been activated.
It was at one tenth the speed as the single target Active Loot Absorption, but Noah didn't have to do anything!

His enemies were already being drained of who they were as from their deaths, Noah would be able to get his hands on the Automaton Boundary Modulators, memories of the Ancestors, and memories of the Lands outside the Barren Lands.
There were too many gains as Noah affirmed the Ancestral Descendants could release Aeonic Damage Values upwards of 100, but much less than 200 as they had yet to even near it from their attacks.
This meant it was over for them!
So even as Noah daw bundles of loot light coming his way...
"Second Form."
HOONG!
He uttered silently as his body glowed blue.

A stellar force wrapped around him as he moved across space so fast that he appeared before the leading Ancestral Descendant in an instant before she could even react, the terrifying Second Form of the Quintessential Emperor's Annihilation Techniques being cast!
Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg wondrously activated as Noah set the predetermined path of an Infinity symbol to be drawn.

Any being that stood in the way of his Blitzkrieg had to face the pure power of his body that was in itself akin to a weapon that could release 200 Aeonic Damage Values, as well as the stellar force of gravitational light around him that signified his cast skill that released Aeonic Damage Values exceeding 300!
It meant that when he appeared before Serafina to begin forming the path of an Infinity symbol, he was already akin to a cosmic bullet train tearing through space with unstoppable force.
What would happen when an unstoppable force met a very, very movable object that could not withstand the Aeonic Damage Values?
BZZT..SPLAT!

Utter devastation was the only answer as the leading figure of Serafina faced such terrifying damage that everything about her was pulverized in an instant, the golden light of a Boundary that had achieved a Fourth Boundary Layer wrapping around the True Emperor of Quintessence as he mercilessly surged forth while his enemies splattered out of existence!
WAA!
The Seeker of Knowledge and others looked at this scene with awe and even a hint of fear.
Normally, it should have been the Ancestral Descendants who should show immense dominance and power as they carried the Will of the Ancestors whenever they descended onto the Desolate Mausoleum.
Their presence here represented the presence of Ancestors.
Yet as one man faced them and dominated in such a shocking fashion that the Great Usurper, Eowyn, Guinevere, and all others nearby gazed in incredulity as they wondered.
Just who was the Ancestor here?! Who was showing the prowess and means more befitting of such a distinction?
Was it truly those beings who had descended and talked high and mighty, or was it this fantastical existence that was dominating them so thoroughly?!

chapters.title: Chapter 2205 Dimension After Dimension! I
paragraphs: Noah could currently see it all.

While his main body was connected to the Source of Reality and resonating with the Fundamental Treasures of Nature, his gaze upon the Prana Dimension was utterly clear as he could see his 2 Dimensional Chassis that stood beside the Pocket Dimensional Reality.
He could see Eowyn, Guinevere, and all the others who stood gaping with shock as they gazed at a scene even he wouldn't forget!
A scene of him clashing with Ancestral Descendants again as the last time he did so..a Clone was killed.
Katya had blared out with her authority and actually killed a True Sanguine Clone as for this- she would pay soon.

But he gazed at his Prana Dimensional Chassis as it utterly eviscerated the enemies that stood before it, its body being covered by the light of Boundaries as every Ancestral Descendant on the path of the Infinity symbol being drawn..turned into a burst of light.
SHIING!
They had Legions of Aeonic Undead around them.

Serafina had her Gehenna Aeonic Undead Daemons near her as they had been pulled towards the heavy gravitational force of the symbol being carved as their bodies folded in and became crushed by the force of Infinite density and mass!

The cerulean light was deafening as those that weren't on the path of the Infinity symbol could not escape the gravitational pull as if this symbol was a singularity, unbelievable despair present on their faces as they urged their authority to emanate out and stop what was occurring without any results.
This was exactly the scene they feared and came across some times before in the Vaults of Extremity.
Extremely powerful creatures that some squadrons or Legions came across as it was so powerful that the whole Legion would be wiped out or merely a single being could manage to survive!

They just didn't expect to be in the middle of this scene in the Barren Lands as due to the sheer speed that the True Emperor of Quintessence had, the Infinity symbol was curved out with the dense blue hue lighting up like the birth of a Reality.

This light was the effect of the Unparalleled Emperor's Blitzkrieg as it released an attractive force that pulled in any Ancestral Descendants or Aeonic Undead that weren't directly on Noah's path but contained within the Infinity symbol or outside of it.
A Gravitational pull that crushed their bodies before soon after...
HOOONG!
The Infinity symbol exploded out and finished its path of Cataclysm.

A few hundred Aeonic Damage Values spread out as an Area of Effect Damage that erased all enemies, even the golden blood being eviscerated out of existence as only dull Automaton Boundary Modulator floated freely!

The man adorned with the Throne that represented his rulership in this Age came to a stop at the edge of the cerulean light of death, his body shimmering with a dazzling regality that made others fearful of even being near him.

The crescendo of a symphony died down just as quickly as it had started as this being turned around to see the devastation he had done- to see the results of all Ancestral Descendants and their Aeonic Undead utterly erased from a single attack of his.
He waved his hands to collect the dull Automaton Boundary Modulator as his voice emanated out.
"It seems | can move much, much faster if this is the quality that common Ancestral Descendants can reach."

He stroked his chin as if he hadn't done anything much, gazing at the prompts of loot and destroyed space that was being pulled towards the Pocket Dimensional Reality as he saw this process would soon be completed.

Eckert stared towards him wordlessly as he and many others seemed to have no words to even speak when they recalled how they were getting thrashed by these beings, and Noah had simply erased them with a single move!
They received a glimpse as to why this being had taken the Throne of this Age!
<16x Crimson Quintessential Treasure Caches have been obtained.>
Before his eyes, fantastical prompts came down along with bursts of memories.
<47x Obsidian Quintessential Treasure Caches have been obtained.>
<88,375x Golden Quintessential Treasure Caches have been obtained.>
Loot from Ancestral Descendants, their most powerful Aeonic Undead, and their Legions of somewhat weak Aeonic Undead all flowed to Noah's Loot filled Expansive Space!
The Loot that he obtained was always relative to his level of power and what his enemies could provide him as after LOOT greatly elevated their quality and quantity
If the existences he killed were much weaker than him as their Origins didn't provide much to him, their Loot or Caches would not be as prominent!

An example was how the NULLITY Beasts that the Tribunal Rulers summoned had given Noah millions of Golden Quintessential Treasure Caches, while the Tribunal Rulers themselves granted him Obsidian Quintessential Treasure Caches.
That was all due to what the Aspects of these beings could offer relative to him.
The Aspects of the Ancestral Descendants....seemed to be truly fruitful to him as he attained Crimson Quintessential Treasure Caches through them!

Caches that were put on the back burner to be opened soon as at this moment, Noah also calculated even the smallest changes he could feel on the Boundary of LOOT after he attained droves of loot just now.
The more Loot he obtained, the stronger the Augmentation to the All Aeonic Parameter Values provided by his Boundary of LOOT.
And from the bundles of Loot he attained just now..he saw the Value jump from 100% to All Aeonic Parameter Values to 102%!
It meant the Loot contained in the many Caches was bound to be abundant!
All that was left..was to see how Noah would utilize it.
And this directly correlated with his path forward.
After his 9 Dimensional Realities each swirling with trillions of Kainos Royal Cosmos, where exactly would his Realm go?!

His Realm would contain unique planes of existence that would connect to genuine planes through his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality. An unfathomable construct that could contain Planes of Existence and move with autonomy...the sheer possibilities and results for what Noah could do with this in the future to come were pure ecstasy to think about!

chapters.title: Chapter 2206 Dimension After Dimension! II
paragraphs: Among the many continuing boons of the rise of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was the Dimensional Reality Xyston.
The Spear like weapon that Noah could already tell would soon surpass EPOCH Relics as it devoured more and more Realities along with the incoming Dimensions!

This wasn't to mention the countless other features of this construct as Noah planned to utilize them to the fullest with all his clones, his eyes seeing far as he saw the devouring and assimilation of the Prana Dimension around him near its end.
He turned to the strongest Vassals under him as he could see their expressions were somber.
His power was too great. The discrepancy between them was too vast!
Others could barely meet his gaze due to their regal positions like Guinevere.
And only the golden eyes of Eowyn and the cerulean eyes of Eckert looked at him head-on without fear as he smiled!

And when he looked at Eckert and the Undead Legions around him, he stroked his chin as he could see a way to at least rapidly increase the strength of this being due to his unique Subjugation ability, where just like he did with the Mirror of Death..Noah could aid in the Great Usurper Subjugating an Ancestral Descendant or their Aeonic Undead Legions as if Eckert's soul could handle it...

He would experience a massive jump in power from barely being able to deal Aeonic Damage Values due to the False Epochal Blade of Quintessence to being able to deal hundreds of Aeonic Damage Values through those he subjugated.

It allowed Noah to think of smoother and quicker methods of increasing the power of his people as his thoughts veered towards the concept of Undead and even Summoning- thinking back to his past Animus Summons that if he re-worked authority relating to it or even forged a Boundary related to it..the benched Blue Slime, Tiamat, Golden Crow..and many others could make their return in a grand fashion!
He had the overabundance of Loot. He had the enemies. All that was left was to act.
"Alright, let's do it like this."
A plan formed in his mind as in the next instant...
WAP!

The last vestiges of the Prana Dimension disappeared as only NULLITY Rifts were left behind, a space of nothingness being the only thing present as in the Desolate Mausoleum- waves of natural laws began to rise as another Anchor was removed.
At such a grand accomplishment, Noah didn't even bat an eye as his Will caused the False Epochal Blades of Quintessence to pulse.
"The next target has been chosen."
He spoke with a smile as the foldings of space twisted while rifts began to bloom in front of the Holders of the False Epochal Blades of Quintessence.

"Follow the path leading to Fantasia. We shall wade through one Dimension after another today as after countless Billions of years since its suppression..the Desolate Mausoleum shall be bound no longer."
HUUM!
His words caused Providence to churn as the Natural Laws inside his body buzzed vibrantly.
He made a vow that had shocking repercussions if followed and carried out, Reality itself bearing evidence through him!

Just like the others, Noah's Prana Dimensional Chassis entered the folds of space and began to traverse through the walls of Dimensions and Reality, his figure tunneling through the folds of the spacetime continuum as he knew exactly where he needed to go.

His Main Body in the unique space that contained the Source of Reality experienced the fervor and explosion in essence the moment that the verdant pike was removed from the vibrant source that became even brighter, the Natural Laws exerting even greater influence as he could feel the rise in their power!
He didn't linger on this as he instantly shifted his vision towards his next target.
Fantasia.
A Dimension that used to be covered by beautiful waves of blue light all around, dense bodies of stellar waters and Lineages connected to the sea being found in abundance in this location.
Other civilizations lived above stellar blue clouds and forged vibrant Empires ruled by wizardry and magic, but at this moment...it was all dark like all other domains affected by the VOID.

In here, the forces of the True Emperor of Fate, Hideyoshi- were authoritatively moving in abundance even in the midst of the ever present void as they looked like golden titans floating through the dark blue seas!

Rifts of NULLITY were present here as well, the figures of 32 Ancestral Descendants adorned in Bone Armaments tinged with a golden hue and utterly fantastical musculatures hidden underneath this armor currently moving together as they brought this Dimension towards a slow Cataclysm.

And they were continuing on this path as their golden bodies released waves of a vibrant Boundary, the one placed as the Leader of this Squadron squinting his sharp eyes at this moment as he began to see the foldings of space ripping apart near them as the auras of multiple Epochal Relics could be felt stepping out!
Along with an aura that caused his eyes and the eyes of the other Ancestral Descendants to turn grim.
It was the aura of a Commander Tier existence that they knew very well as the visage of the recently crowned True Emperor of Quintessence appeared before them with shining eyes!
Dimension after Dimension without stopping.

This was what Noah wanted to do as this chance given by the blanket of the VOID that prevented the effects of the Natural Laws to be expressed outside of the Barren Lands until it was too late..he had to take full advantage of it before any changes occurred!
So his clones moved with haste as after confirming his power, he didn't just stop at arriving in the Fantasia Dimension with the Prana Dimensional Chassis.

He had the Dream Dimensional Chassis bring and protect the Pocket Dimensional Reality into this Dimension for its assimilation, and he also sent the Mirror and Avalon Clones into the Mirror Dimension to begin devouring this Dimension while meeting the remaining one third of Yvonne's forces!
"Yvonne.."

Noah uttered this name from his Elysium Dimensional Chassis that was still in the depths of the Soul Library, his halcyon figure floating before 2 massive grimoires labeled [The Vaults of Extremity] and [Ancestors of the Planes of the Barren Lands].

Yvonne was the Ancestral Descendant Commander currently fighting The NOBLESSE that moved behind the dark in all this, Noah having a lot of information about her and multiple others as he also had the image of Hideyoshi and the one known as Theseus ingrained in his mind!
He had begun to sort through and record down the trillions of years of memories of the Ancestral Descendants he just killed as he gained a grander picture of what was out there and how things worked.
As he attained a surge of knowledge on different types of Boundaries and how they were ranked in their Tiers.
As he saw just how beings progressed through their Realms towards EXTREMITY!

sentences.text: Among the many continuing boons of the rise of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was the Dimensional Reality Xyston.
The Spear like weapon that Noah could already tell would soon surpass EPOCH Relics as it devoured more and more Realities along with the incoming Dimensions!

This wasn't to mention the countless other features of this construct as Noah planned to utilize them to the fullest with all his clones, his eyes seeing far as he saw the devouring and assimilation of the Prana Dimension around him near its end.
He turned to the strongest Vassals under him as he could see their expressions were somber.
His power was too great.
The discrepancy between them was too vast!
Others could barely meet his gaze due to their regal positions like Guinevere.
And only the golden eyes of Eowyn and the cerulean eyes of Eckert looked at him head-on without fear as he smiled!

And when he looked at Eckert and the Undead Legions around him, he stroked his chin as he could see a way to at least rapidly increase the strength of this being due to his unique Subjugation ability, where just like he did with the Mirror of Death..Noah could aid in the Great Usurper Subjugating an Ancestral Descendant or their Aeonic Undead Legions as if Eckert's soul could handle it...

He would experience a massive jump in power from barely being able to deal Aeonic Damage Values due to the False Epochal Blade of Quintessence to being able to deal hundreds of Aeonic Damage Values through those he subjugated.

It allowed Noah to think of smoother and quicker methods of increasing the power of his people as his thoughts veered towards the concept of Undead and even Summoning- thinking back to his past Animus Summons that if he re-worked authority relating to it or even forged a Boundary related to it..the benched Blue Slime, Tiamat, Golden Crow..and many others could make their return in a grand fashion!
He had the overabundance of Loot.
He had the enemies.
All that was left was to act.
"Alright, let's do it like this."
A plan formed in his mind as in the next instant...
WAP!

The last vestiges of the Prana Dimension disappeared as only NULLITY Rifts were left behind, a space of nothingness being the only thing present as in the Desolate Mausoleum- waves of natural laws began to rise as another Anchor was removed.
At such a grand accomplishment, Noah didn't even bat an eye as his Will caused the False Epochal Blades of Quintessence to pulse.
"The next target has been chosen."
He spoke with a smile as the foldings of space twisted while rifts began to bloom in front of the Holders of the False Epochal Blades of Quintessence.
"Follow the path leading to Fantasia.
We shall wade through one Dimension after another today as after countless Billions of years since its suppression..the Desolate Mausoleum shall be bound no longer."
HUUM!
His words caused Providence to churn as the Natural Laws inside his body buzzed vibrantly.
He made a vow that had shocking repercussions if followed and carried out, Reality itself bearing evidence through him!

Just like the others, Noah's Prana Dimensional Chassis entered the folds of space and began to traverse through the walls of Dimensions and Reality, his figure tunneling through the folds of the spacetime continuum as he knew exactly where he needed to go.

His Main Body in the unique space that contained the Source of Reality experienced the fervor and explosion in essence the moment that the verdant pike was removed from the vibrant source that became even brighter, the Natural Laws exerting even greater influence as he could feel the rise in their power!
He didn't linger on this as he instantly shifted his vision towards his next target.
Fantasia.
A Dimension that used to be covered by beautiful waves of blue light all around, dense bodies of stellar waters and Lineages connected to the sea being found in abundance in this location.
Other civilizations lived above stellar blue clouds and forged vibrant Empires ruled by wizardry and magic, but at this moment...it was all dark like all other domains affected by the VOID.

In here, the forces of the True Emperor of Fate, Hideyoshi- were authoritatively moving in abundance even in the midst of the ever present void as they looked like golden titans floating through the dark blue seas!

Rifts of NULLITY were present here as well, the figures of 32 Ancestral Descendants adorned in Bone Armaments tinged with a golden hue and utterly fantastical musculatures hidden underneath this armor currently moving together as they brought this Dimension towards a slow Cataclysm.

And they were continuing on this path as their golden bodies released waves of a vibrant Boundary, the one placed as the Leader of this Squadron squinting his sharp eyes at this moment as he began to see the foldings of space ripping apart near them as the auras of multiple Epochal Relics could be felt stepping out!
Along with an aura that caused his eyes and the eyes of the other Ancestral Descendants to turn grim.
It was the aura of a Commander Tier existence that they knew very well as the visage of the recently crowned True Emperor of Quintessence appeared before them with shining eyes!
Dimension after Dimension without stopping.

This was what Noah wanted to do as this chance given by the blanket of the VOID that prevented the effects of the Natural Laws to be expressed outside of the Barren Lands until it was too late..he had to take full advantage of it before any changes occurred!
So his clones moved with haste as after confirming his power, he didn't just stop at arriving in the Fantasia Dimension with the Prana Dimensional Chassis.

He had the Dream Dimensional Chassis bring and protect the Pocket Dimensional Reality into this Dimension for its assimilation, and he also sent the Mirror and Avalon Clones into the Mirror Dimension to begin devouring this Dimension while meeting the remaining one third of Yvonne's forces!
"Yvonne.."

Noah uttered this name from his Elysium Dimensional Chassis that was still in the depths of the Soul Library, his halcyon figure floating before 2 massive grimoires labeled [The Vaults of Extremity] and [Ancestors of the Planes of the Barren Lands].

Yvonne was the Ancestral Descendant Commander currently fighting The NOBLESSE that moved behind the dark in all this, Noah having a lot of information about her and multiple others as he also had the image of Hideyoshi and the one known as Theseus ingrained in his mind!
He had begun to sort through and record down the trillions of years of memories of the Ancestral Descendants he just killed as he gained a grander picture of what was out there and how things worked.
As he attained a surge of knowledge on different types of Boundaries and how they were ranked in their Tiers.
As he saw just how beings progressed through their Realms towards EXTREMITY!

chapters.title: Chapter 2207 Boundaries And Echelons! I
paragraphs: 2207 Boundaries and Echelons! I
Memories of trillions of years swirled in Noah's mind as he gazed upon the nature of events and workings of the Lands these beings had explored outside of the Barren Lands.
All of the information was crucial to go through, with Noah's focus placed on the aspect of Realm Progression and Boundaries!

Those who veered away from Nature Integration Realm had the status of Boundary Expansion- a Realm that the vast majority of Existences spent on as within it were sub-Realms to distinguish just how far an existence had risen in their Expansion of Boundaries.

The NOBLESSE that was making moves at this moment was known as an <8 Echelon Obsidian> NOBLESSE from the information that the Will of Reality had granted him, and Noah became even more somber from this as he perused the memories of Serafina and others!
Such a being was not to be looked down upon as they were the types of existences who would take up the role of Legion Commanders. Commanders who controlled multiple Commanders and their Legions!

The 8 in the <8 Echelon Obsidian> demarcated that this being had 8 Boundaries under him, and the Obsidian title distinguished that had achieved at least 4 Boundary Layers in a majority of these 8 Boundaries.

A ranking of Golden meant an existence had no Boundaries past the 3rd Boundary Layer, and a ranking of Crimson meant an existence had achieved the Six Boundary Layers or more in a majority of their Boundaries.
Golden, Obsidian, and Crimson! 3 Boundary Layers and below, 4-5 Boundary Layers, and 6 Boundary Layers or more..respectively!

Most Commanders were in the Obsidian Echelon with their Boundaries only ever reaching the 4th or 5th levels, with the power coming from reaching the 6th Boundary Layer being utterly disastrous that such existences were distinguished as having truly stepped on the Road to EXTREMITY.
That their pathway was clear, and they just had to follow it!

Currently, Noah should have had the label of a 2 Echelon Golden Existence due to his Boundary of Loot and Quintessence that reached the Third and First Boundary Layers respectively, but because the First Boundary Layer of Quintessence had the effect of pushing his other Boundaries up by one and made his Boundary of Loot achieve 4 Layers, he could be ranked as a 2 Echelon Obsidian Existence!
It was far, far away from an 8 Tier Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE.

He didn't know how many of the 8 Boundaries this existence expanded were at 3, 4, or 5 Boundary Layers. He didn't know just what ridiculous boosts this being received from each of these Boundaries as just his Boundary of Loot alone gave him ridiculous boosts at the Third Layer.
There was a lot he didn't know as another concept to keep in mind was the ranking of the Boundaries such a being also held.
At this stage, Noah's mind focused on how different Boundaries were segregated.
The vast amount of Boundaries that beings understood and expanded towards EXTREMITY were at the very first level that was known as Planar Boundary!
Paths and Modus Operandi that came from the countless Planes of Existence.
Concepts like Karma, Fate, and Natural Laws all fell into Planar Boundaries!
And within Planar Boundaries, there was a three tier segregation of Golden, Obsidian, and Crimson to demarcate the ease of taking the chosen Boundary towards EXTREMITY and the power it could display.

The Ancestors designated Natural Laws as Golden Planar Boundaries which were the lowest of the low, and they would even place it lower if they could due to just their extreme hardship in being elevated even past the First Boundary Layer, and the fact that they latched onto those from their Planes without letting go- restricting them with their boundaries overtime!
The more unique a Boundary was, the greater its standing could be as it could be designated as an Obsidian Planar Boundary or a Crimson Planar Boundary.

The concepts that defined an Age like Karma and Destiny..they were the reason why True Emperors had an edge and more power outside the Barren Lands as their Boundaries always started as Obsidian Planar Boundaries, with the more unique ones even receiving the Tier of a Crimson Planar Boundary!
They came close to the second Tier of Boundaries.
Boundaries that one could not attain simply by working hard for them- Boundaries that one had to access through their Lineage!
What came after Planar Boundaries was Innate Boundaries.
HUUM!
Waves of Providence surged as Noah's will inscribed these golden words onto the grimoire of [The Vaults of Extremity].
Innate!

Boundaries that could only be accessed through one's Lineage as your Bloodline...truly had to be raised to a ridiculous extent to be capable of even birthing a Boundary that could be brought towards Extremity.
When Noah arrived at the memories of this concept, he thought about his own Lineage.

The Lineage of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor that was still stuck at ZENITH and was waiting for him to absorb and assimilate the other ZENITH Lineages he had obtained from the Infinite Forge! But in his heart, he felt like even with all this..he may not be able to elevate his Lineage to the extent that it could birth a Boundary.
This was something the NOBLESSE were blessed with!

They had their Bloodline Boundary of the VOID- an Innate Boundary that was far greater in power than Planar Boundaries as in the Tier of Innate Boundaries that was also differentiated into Golden, Obsidian, and Crimson, the VOID Boundary was designated as an Obsidian Innate Boundary.
It wasn't as the extreme peak of the Innate Boundaries, and yet the Ancestors were utterly thrashed against these beings when they met them in the Havens of Extremity!
None of this accounted for any other Lineages from other Planes of Existence.
None of this accounted for Chaoticus Beasts and the other rare Lineages wading through the Havens of Extremity!

Noah wondered about his own Bloodline and what he could do to elevate it to such an extent that it could birth a Boundary, thinking of even the possibility of first forming a Boundary related to Blood or Sanguinity for him to continue the path of the Sanguine Emperor.
Many possibilities came and went as nothing was decided currently, Noah continuing to sort through the vast amounts of information laid out before him!

chapters.title: Chapter 2208 Boundaries And Echelons! II
paragraphs: 2208 Boundaries and Echelons! II

The Innate Boundaries stemming from Lineages earned such a high ranking partly because those taking them towards EXTREMITY..were heavily supported by the Resonance between their Bloodline and Boundary as traversing an Innate Boundary towards EXTREMITY was much easier than other Boundaries.
This was one of the factors, with another being the extreme power and potency such Boundaries showed!
The Lineage of Chaoticus Beasts that Originated from NULLITY itself..the truly powerful ones among them who fought against the NOBLESSE seeking to subjugate them also had an Innate Boundary.
It was reserved for those with pristine Lineages as such a ranking stood above Planar Boundary!
Then, there came another ranking above this.
Planar, Innate, and then there were Consummate Boundaries.
Consummate!
A word that indicated something superlative! Something of the greatest quality!
It was a ranking that when Noah saw the memories of, he instantly thought of his own Boundary of Quintessence.
This term also stood for something that was of the greatest quality or the most ideal example!
It seemed this term was reaching for this level and beyond as when he thought about how this was a Boundary that could advance in tiers..it also left the way open for many possibilities.
"So after Planar, Innate, and Consummate, there is.."
His voice was magnetic as the Authority of Providence and Elysium swirled around him, the golden words of the goal of all beings in the Vaults of Extremity being revealed.
Extremity.
A stage of Boundaries too pristine to imagine.
The goal of all powerful beings was to bring their Boundary towards EXTREMITY.
If an existence ever managed to do so, this Boundary of theirs would instantly supersede all others and arrive at the very top!
If a Planar Boundary that was so extremely hard to advance through the Boundary Layers could reach Extremity, it could become a Boundary of such a rank!
It was the True stage of power.
"Mmm, Desiderius .."
Countless bursts of information continued to be organized in Noah's mind as he tried to correctly gauge the current enemies he faced.
The 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE was the greatest issue as his true aim seemed to be so very clear and at the same time not.
Desiderius!
A name that Noah only thought of as an instant later, his connection with the Source of Reality that was kept in Resonance picked up on his words as its Will emanated out soon after!
<<This being is of extreme danger. He is currently ripping apart the Boundaries of the one titled The Conqueror.>
WAA!
In the Source of Reality.
Noah's main body sat on the True Throne of Quintessence as he measured how much True Authority of this Age there was to elevate his Boundaries when these shocking words rang out.

His other Clones had just arrived in the Fantasia to begin devouring this Dimension while battling its Ancestral Descendants, but other beings didn't just sit still during this time as they also made their moves!
Desiderius had been battling Yvonne the Conqueror this whole time as due to his immense might, this fight was now nearing its close!
"Let's see.."
He was curious about this being's power while at the same time, he also needed to react very quickly depending on what he did after this being won his fight.

So apart from continuing the Absorption of the Fantasia Dimension, another two Clones of his appeared in the Mirror Dimension where his third clone that was accompanying Katelyn was the one to even secretly lay out another source of the Pocket Dimensional Reality!

Her mother at the stage of a Dimensional Ruler and all those who stood with the Quantum Dimension would be left behind after everything was assimilated, where even the plans of leaving the Barren Lands through the Pylon of Ascendancy to arrive into the strongholds of the Ancestors was put into question.
But there would be many more possibilities in the future as Noah planned to keep Katelyn and the connection to her Mother who had the trust of Quantum Dimensional Rulers active.
Noah did all this as he had to move quickly.
If he managed to smoothly devour and assimilate Fantasia and Mirror, only the Dimensions of Quantum, Elysium, and Niflheim would be left with their Ancestral Descendant Commanders!
And now Niflheim..was being put in the spotlight as Noah's will shifted.
The Fundamental Treasures of Nature inside him buzzed as his gaze of the vastness of Reality changed from the Fantasia Dimension and into the Niflheim Dimension.
Here, a fantastically horrific scene was displayed.
It was the scene of what an Obsidian Innate Boundary could do against an existence that still only had a Planar Boundary- no matter if the Boundary of Death was Obsidian or Crimson in ranking!
Legions of Aeonic Undead lay shattered and broken.
No matter if they were different variations of the Gehenna Aeonic Undead Daemons from the Gehenna Plane that the Ancestors won wars against.
No matter if it was the Undead Chaoticus Beasts reigned in by the Boundary of Death!
All of them lay tattered and broken as an existence with Obsidian rings around his limbs and head towered over them like an indomitable giant!

A devilish smile was ever present on his face as currently, he gazed at the visage of Yvonne that was shockingly contained in what looked like a sacrificial altar- black blood leaking out of her orifices currently as the might and grandeur of a Commander was stripped down.

At the center of the Obsidian altar, there was a constantly pulsating sepulcher formed of black blood that formed layers and layers of defensive barriers that were each exceeding the Boundary of a thousand Aeonic Values from what Noah could see!
Each!
The Boundary of Death pervasively spread all around maddeningly as if it didn't want the one utilizing it to meet the Natural end of death itself!

Shocking prowess and might was being displayed here as Noah saw the NOBLESSE emanate a fantastical light of a Boundary and shred apart these layers of defenses exceeding thousands as if they were paper!

chapters.title: Chapter 2209 I Am The Kingmaker! I
paragraphs: 2209 I Am the Kingmaker! I
She was an Ancestral Descendant, and yet she had joined the list of respected existences with the accolade of Conqueror.
Conqueror!
A distinguished title for the existences stemming from the Barren Lands!

It meant she was able to occupy and recover regions in the Vaults of Extremity and bring them under the command of the Ancestors as she fought back against NOBLESSE Commanders with her Legions of Aeonic Undead and the Legions of others under her.
She commanded the Boundary of Death and even elevated it to the Fourth Boundary Layer!
When this was paired with 3 other Boundaries under her, her might was exceptional.
She was a 4 Echelon Obsidian Existence as her power was mighty!
And yet...
SQUELCH!
Desperation and grimness were ever present on her face before the might of this NOBLESSE Commander.
She was surrounded by surging black blood in a sepulcher of her own making, the altar around it shining with death as she was burning her very Aeonic Soul to try and stop this being!
But he held a cruel smile on his face as the Obsidian Halos around him shone with malice and brilliance.
"Did you think you could escape the glory of NOBLESSE in a place like this?"

His voice was magnetic as the ancient base of imperial cruelty deep in the Lineage of the NOBLESSE rose out from this being, his body giving off Obsidian waves of darkness as his hand motioned upwards.
SHIIING!
The void deformed as above the dreary skies of Niflheim, a singularity bloomed.

The control over the void for the being motioning his hand was so experienced that this Singularity of Infinite density and mass was actually being carved by him, being formed into a dazzling Obsidian palm that buzzed with a terrifying force of a singularity as this palm..it began to descend unto Yvonne as it didn't just light up with the Authority of a single Boundary.
Apart from the Obsidian light of the void, a distinct grandeur of red, blue, and white covered this palm.
4 Boundaries carved a palm that smashed towards her, this attack being distinct as it was Desiderius telling her she was akin to a bug beneath him that he could crush with his mere palm!
"I have played with you enough. You can go ahead and join your Ancestors..many more will soon follow."
HUUM!

Yvonne's hair moved with torrential waves as the authority around her raged, all the grandeur of a Boundary Expansion expert having all but faded before the descending palm arrived even before she could react.
A palm filled with myste ies and power even she could not fathom!
Desperation filled her eyes and face as she screamed out while mustering the remaining dredges of her Soul, the sepulcher around her gushing with even more black blood as...

An impact that destroyed sound itself occurred- a shocking scene blooming as even though a single Obsidian palm had been descending from the skies, at the moment of impact..an illusory palm just like it appeared from the bottom and crushed everything together at a center point.
No sound.
Two points of Infinite mass and density met while supported by multiple Boundaries as when the two palms separated...

Pure horror could be seen as the soul of an Ancestral Descendant Commander had been crushed under the weight of thousands of Aeonic Damage Values as mangled musculature and black blood flowed serenely- with all of this gory mass moving as the mouth of the 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE opened to fantastically devour everything!
The remained visage of Yvonne the Conqueror, her remains of Aeonic Undead, Ancestral Descendants, and the corpses and blood of anything that moved along with the Automaton Boundary Modulators!
The NOBLESSE was a lineage that devoured everything of their enemies.

A devilish smile was etched on this being's face as he licked his lips and gazed at the blatant destruction, his Halos glinting with an even brighter sheen as after he eliminated all his enemies...his head turned upwards unnaturally.

His visage was towering and ancient to look at as wings of pure Obsidian essence overflowed behind him while Obsidian rings of light covered the sides of his face and limbs- and this being now gazed upwards as with his eyes giving off a glint of age and time, he spoke out grandly!
"I feel a gaze from the very layers of Reality."
WAA!
Hidden beneath the cruelty, a shocking ancientness could be felt from the eyes of this being that were pure black.
Regality and nobility emanated from them even amidst the savagery!
"It must be you...if you have managed to resonate with your Plane while you hold its Key. We finally meet, O True Emperor of Quintessence."
As if his gaze could pierce through the very veils of Reality. As if he could meet Noah's will pervading through the Niflheim Dimension!
BZZT!
Unseen waves of Providence seethed as from the Layers of Reality, Noah's Will gazed back.

The Fundamental Treasures of Nature he was connected to along with the Source of Reality were pulled upon as if Noah had the authority to displace Dimensions and even the existence within it utilizing the pure white authority of this Era, he could also do something as simple as transmitting his Will!
So when this ancient existence took the initiative to communicate, Noah spoke back.
<Who are you...and what is it that you seek, O Desiderius?>
BOOOM!
His voice was calm, and yet the surrounding folds of Reality instantly shattered after his sentence finished as Noah..had addressed the name of this NOBLESSE!
A name he shouldn't know!
And he..didn't put any respect that this name truly deserved.

Desiderius turned his head to the side as the burst of power that destroyed the fabric of Reality for light years in the surroundings receded, Reality not healing at the very least as rifts of NULLITY spread throughout!
"Yes, gaining access to the Key of this Plane can allow you to see the vestiges of memories across the river of time. Did you catch my name from the history of the past True Emperor?"
His ancientness and nobility only increased as his devilish smile faded and he became utterly calm!

chapters.title: Chapter 2210 I Am The Kingmaker! II
paragraphs: 2210 I Am the Kingmaker! II
"...Did you catch my name from the history of the past True Emperor?"
His voice retained its nobility and ancientness as he spoke, his body emanating utmost power as he now spoke out calmly.
This being knew himself very well, and he also knew where he would have mentioned himself and his identity across his history in these Planes of Existence!
And this time was with the last Key that had spurred and put many more things in motion.
Desiderius had a calm smile as he thought of this, his voice echoing out amidst the decimated Reality.
"Who am l...this is but an easy question that you should know the answer to, O True Emperor of Quintessence."
WAA!
"I am..how do they say it? Ah, yes. I am a Kingmaker. I forge kings and True Emperors in these Planes."
"I crown True Emperors..and I steered the gazes of the so-called Ancestors away from easily perceiving the True Emperor of Destiny and even you. I..crowned you."
BOOOM!
Torrential waves of authority emanated out at such grand statements.
Kingmaker!
The one that crowned Kings and Emperors!
Such slanderous words were released from this being as Noah's Will gazed on coldly.
He didn't have an outburst or react in any way.
He thought of OPPENHEIMER's path and how this being was connected to Desiderius, where his words may be true for the accession of the True Emperor of Destiny!
But himself? The True Emperor of Quintessence did not become one through the means of others!
Noah knew of the perils he faced and overcome to arrive where he was today as when this being said this, he didn't even engage as he asked again for what was truly important.
<Grand accolades and assertions, but they don't answer the goal you have for these Barren Lands.>
The surroundings buzzed with Noah's voice as if it was Reality itself speaking out in the surroundings.
And the air of nobility and ancientness around Desiderius only increased as he floated like an unshakable titan in the void of space, his aged voice ringing out.
"My goal here...is the full destruction of the 9 Minor Planes, this one here included."
His majestic hands waved to the surroundings of the Niflheim Dimension as he continued.

"I have a duty to make sure that when the veil of the void descends, the Major Plane of Existence that your so called Ancestors stemmed from...i need to make sure that they fully re-impose the bindings of their Natural Laws onto those who dare to gaze towards our Lineage.
A straightforward reply!
It was Desiderius giving the newly risen Emperor that had escalated things to this point recognition enough to simply answer him on something so simple!
And the pondering voice of the True Emperor of Quintessence gained a bit of sharpness as he questioned.
<Must it be destruction? I can utilize the authority as the True Emperor to remove the rest of the Anchors, and you would achieve the same result.>
The waters were tested.
The True Emperor of the Age of Genesis had said that the NOBLESSE were clear enemies, no matter what their intentions seemed!
Now, Noah was affirming this for himself.
And the answer was clear.
"No, O True Emperor of Quintessence."
HUUM!
The fabric of Reality pulsed as a desolate aura emanated from the NOBLESSE shining with Obsidian grandeur.

"Just like how you were able to undo what your Ancestors did, they can also undo what you are currently doing. My aim is not to re-impose bindings on them now only to have them suppress the Major Plane of Existence again. It is the complete destruction of all the Minor Planes that guarantees my work here..even the ones you have displaced and have hidden. I will have to trace them and erase them as well, so I do thank you for bringing them all together."
WAAA!
The future could play out in a myriad of paths.
And now, many possible Paths shattered as only a single one was presenting itself.
Desiderius seemed to know this very well as his ancient titanic gaze turned upwards again as he voiced out.

"I had a great relationship with the True Emperor of Destiny. I don't see why we cannot be the same. You can end the Cycles of the Ages and reign in the Major Plane of Existence as the last True Emperor of these lands.The Minor Planes of Existence will have to fall, this is something you cannot change."
As if to show what he meant with his words, his body that was releasing waves of desolation pointed to the vast stretches of Niflheim from afar as tendrils of NULLITY began to form all around him!
"You were the last Key that I waited for. Your compliance as a key though, is not mandatory. And I do not offer alliances twice. So what shall it be, OSMONT?"
HUUM!
Serene waves of Destiny and Providence flowed out.
An offer was made in the Age of Destiny as one being had made a choice.
Once more, an offer was made in the Age of Quintessence as here as well..a choice was made!
From the silent foldings of Reality, the voice of the True Emperor of Quintessence emanated out with unshakable strength and valor!
<The 9 Dimensions will not fall.>
Simple.
As if this would be the only result!
Desiderius shook his head at this as if it was a pity.

"Even with the utilization of all the Authority of this Age, you could at most expand a Boundary to the Fourth Boundary Layer. And that is if you're somewhat talented.It is a pity when beings who could rise to greatness are presented with the opportunity, but you rely on emotions more than logic. It is why your Ancestors left behind this weakness all those years ago as it comes to bite them in the back now even if they have learned and are trying to cut it off currently. And it is why a Key like you..will never be able to open any more doors."
BZZZT!
Immense waves of NULLITY as if it was an endless sea about to surge out erupted from this being.
If these waves were released, they would no doubt irreparably decimate the Niflheim Dimension and ruin whatever remained of its Source!
Desiderius flexed his power and made his move.
And the True Emperor of Quintessence..also made his move to save this Dimension!
