chapters.title: Chapter 2222 The Palisades! II
paragraphs: 2222 The Palisades! II
<There is no time to waste, let's go!>
HUUM!
Over a dozen Automaton Boundary Modulators released a blinding light as a thin transparent barrier emanated from each of them and enclosed the groups of Royal Lineages in circular domes of light.

The Ancestral Descendant named Clytemnestra shouted out as the Authority of Boundary of Karma emanated from her, painting over the thin layer of circular light covering everyone as radiance emanated out!

Clytemnestra then nodded towards True Empress Katya as 5 other Ancestral Descendants took different positions across two enacted Boundaries of light supported by Automaton Boundary Modulators, serving as protection from anything they might come across.
SHAA!

A rift was carved out before them as with Clytemnestra leading the way, two circles of light covered by the Authority of the Boundary of Karma disappeared into the folds of space as they began to traverse the folds of Dimensions and Reality, nobody knowing how much time it would take to even leave the walls of the Barren Lands and enter the Planar Palisades of Extremity!
The first group was led by Clytemnestra as Charlemagne was included in it among other Quantum Dimensional Rulers and Grotto Haven royalties.

In the second group led by unnamed Ancestral Descendants, Katelyn followed along as the nondescript man beside her turned back to gaze at the Quantum Dimension and those within it with a diabolical smile, his face turned away just as True Empress Katya turned over as she just happened to miss his smile of Tyranny.

Two parties left to seek reinforcements as there was a question of whether any of them would even make it, the dangers and mysteries of the Planar Palisades of Extremity being something unfathomable as their chances of survival in terms of percentages..did not even reach 30%.

This was begive rise to the vast majority of the Ancestral Descendants leading these two parties were at the First Boundary Layer or Second, with Clytemnestra being the one that touched upon the stage of the Third Boundary Layer of Karma as she was the only reason their chances of survival surged close to 30%!

True Empress Katya saw them off as her Imperial Karmic Scarab form released waves of light, the authorities of her Boundaries continuing to release and keep the VOID at bay while the Legion that Hideyoshi left behind and her remaining forces surrounding this area tightly as they would defend it with their lives.

The Pylon of Ascension was something critical that granted safe passage across the Planar Palisades of Extremity, giving a linear path to follow and at an extremely faster rate at that as nine times out of ten- they wouldn't come across any problems following this path.

It was a construct that connected one end to another with the abstruse workings of Aspects of singularities as on the other side of it..there was a Haven Pylon of Ascension that one would come out from!

Even though the Pylon of Ascension here was blanketed by the VOID, Katya and the remaining Ancestral Descendants were slowly pushing away the authority of this Innate Boundary as she expected within a day or two...they could reclaim some of the functions of the Pylon of Ascension!
For now, they just had to defend against any...
BZZT!
The sound of space tearing emanated out as blazing auras began to appear.

The cluster of Ancestral Descendants in the surroundings blazed with grandiosity as multiple layers of fortifications and barrier filled with the power of Boundaries was enacted, turned to a direction that showed multiple figures wielding radiant blades that were attached to a white gold half-moon crescent disk at the end of the hilt!

One being in particular at the forefront rode atop the silver black Mirror of Death- the massive Draconian Dimensional Hellion Ruler of the Nifiheim Dimension. This being was actually someone they knew as even though his aura felt weaker, it was...
<Assur!>
An Ancestral Descendant from Hideyoshi's Legion bellowed out in shock as he gazed at his brethren's now blue eyes that held a light of coldness.

He felt much weaker than before..but it was his aura and visage even though he gazed towards them with hostility! It was the body of the Ancestral Descendant taken over by the Great Usurper as among the advanced forces sent forward, he now wielded a great deal of more power as without another word, the sword within his hands struck forward.

It didn't contain the light of the Boundary of Fate that this being normally had, but the Body that had been drenched in the light of Boundaries for the past millions of years still carried a trace of this Authority as the Great Usurper knew he could reclaim the Boundaries this being had after he returned its Aeonic Soul to the peak!
He began to speak as today..he wanted to let loose once more.
"Mind Realm. Absolute Mental Isolation Field. The Emperor's Universe. Corruption of the Usurper... Malignant Madness."

The Origin of the being he subjugated cried out as its resources were plundered and used, its almost destroyed Aeonic Soul pulling out the vestiges of its power to display the heavy debuffing and mental skills of the Great Usurper as a battle bloomed without the other side exchanging words!
HOONG!

The followers of the True Emperor of Fate were frustrated to see one of their own having somehow fallen to those in these Planes, feeling like their pride was ground down and spat on as they erupted with the authorities of Boundaries.
Out of all beings here, the most powerful hadn't made a move yet as just when Katya snorted and roused her Boundary of Karma...
Her Soul felt a tremendous pressure that caused her to turn entirely somber and shocked towards a certain direction where another spatial rift opened.
A direction that showed a devilishly handsome man she had killed before- and the man whose illusory scene while seated upon the Throne was advertised to all!
It was the True Emperor of Quintessence as his arrival caused great shock..due to the blatant and blaring aura of a Commander from him!

The one that appeared before them had verdant black stellar strands of hair as he was adorned in regal green Emperor's robes, his eyes releasing a light of immense coldness as he honed in on True Empress Katya with a burning light!
<Impossible...>
Katya merely uttered out this word as before she could say anymore...
SHAA!

Booming sounds of spatial folds opening echoed out as another blaring aura exactly like the one weighing before them appeared, this one being adorned in a crimson Emperor's robe as a bloody light covered his head!
But this was not all.
The color continued to drain from the faces of all Ancestral Descendants as yes another aura of an Ancestral Descendant Commander appeared thereafter...and another, and another!
WAA!

5 Quintessential Dimensional Chassis appeared before the stronghold of the Ancestral Descendants in the Quantum Dimension, the True Emperor of Quintessence showing he meant business as his sheer aura alone caused a profound sense of oppression and suppression towards these powerful beings!

Two parties left to seek reinforcements as there was a question of whether any of them would even make it, the dangers and mysteries of the Planar Palisades of Extremity being something unfathomable as their chances of survival in terms of percentages..did not even reach 30%.

This was begive rise to the vast majority of the Ancestral Descendants leading these two parties were at the First Boundary Layer or Second, with Clytemnestra being the one that touched upon the stage of the Third Boundary Layer of Karma as she was the only reason their chances of survival surged close to 30%!

True Empress Katya saw them off as her Imperial Karmic Scarab form released waves of light, the authorities of her Boundaries continuing to release and keep the VOID at bay while the Legion that Hideyoshi left behind and her remaining forces surrounding this area tightly as they would defend it with their lives.

The Pylon of Ascension was something critical that granted safe passage across the Planar Palisades of Extremity, giving a linear path to follow and at an extremely faster rate at that as nine times out of ten- they wouldn't come across any problems following this path.

It was a construct that connected one end to another with the abstruse workings of Aspects of singularities as on the other side of it..there was a Haven Pylon of Ascension that one would come out from!

Even though the Pylon of Ascension here was blanketed by the VOID, Katya and the remaining Ancestral Descendants were slowly pushing away the authority of this Innate Boundary as she expected within a day or two...they could reclaim some of the functions of the Pylon of Ascension!
For now, they just had to defend against any...
BZZT!
The sound of space tearing emanated out as blazing auras began to appear.

The cluster of Ancestral Descendants in the surroundings blazed with grandiosity as multiple layers of fortifications and barrier filled with the power of Boundaries was enacted, turned to a direction that showed multiple figures wielding radiant blades that were attached to a white gold half-moon crescent disk at the end of the hilt!
One being in particular at the forefront rode atop the silver black Mirror of Death- the massive Draconian Dimensional Hellion Ruler of the Nifiheim Dimension.
This being was actually someone they knew as even though his aura felt weaker, it was...
<Assur!>
An Ancestral Descendant from Hideyoshi's Legion bellowed out in shock as he gazed at his brethren's now blue eyes that held a light of coldness.
He felt much weaker than before..but it was his aura and visage even though he gazed towards them with hostility!

It was the body of the Ancestral Descendant taken over by the Great Usurper as among the advanced forces sent forward, he now wielded a great deal of more power as without another word, the sword within his hands struck forward.

It didn't contain the light of the Boundary of Fate that this being normally had, but the Body that had been drenched in the light of Boundaries for the past millions of years still carried a trace of this Authority as the Great Usurper knew he could reclaim the Boundaries this being had after he returned its Aeonic Soul to the peak!
He began to speak as today..he wanted to let loose once more.
"Mind Realm.
Absolute Mental Isolation Field.
The Emperor's Universe.
Corruption of the Usurper...
Malignant Madness."

The Origin of the being he subjugated cried out as its resources were plundered and used, its almost destroyed Aeonic Soul pulling out the vestiges of its power to display the heavy debuffing and mental skills of the Great Usurper as a battle bloomed without the other side exchanging words!
HOONG!

The followers of the True Emperor of Fate were frustrated to see one of their own having somehow fallen to those in these Planes, feeling like their pride was ground down and spat on as they erupted with the authorities of Boundaries.
Out of all beings here, the most powerful hadn't made a move yet as just when Katya snorted and roused her Boundary of Karma...
Her Soul felt a tremendous pressure that caused her to turn entirely somber and shocked towards a certain direction where another spatial rift opened.
A direction that showed a devilishly handsome man she had killed before- and the man whose illusory scene while seated upon the Throne was advertised to all!
It was the True Emperor of Quintessence as his arrival caused great shock..due to the blatant and blaring aura of a Commander from him!

The one that appeared before them had verdant black stellar strands of hair as he was adorned in regal green Emperor's robes, his eyes releasing a light of immense coldness as he honed in on True Empress Katya with a burning light!
<Impossible...>
Katya merely uttered out this word as before she could say anymore...
SHAA!

Booming sounds of spatial folds opening echoed out as another blaring aura exactly like the one weighing before them appeared, this one being adorned in a crimson Emperor's robe as a bloody light covered his head!
But this was not all.
The color continued to drain from the faces of all Ancestral Descendants as yes another aura of an Ancestral Descendant Commander appeared thereafter...and another, and another!
WAA!

5 Quintessential Dimensional Chassis appeared before the stronghold of the Ancestral Descendants in the Quantum Dimension, the True Emperor of Quintessence showing he meant business as his sheer aura alone caused a profound sense of oppression and suppression towards these powerful beings!

chapters.title: Chapter 2223 Merely A True Empress! I
paragraphs: 2223 Merely a True Empress! I
Coldness.
Confidence!
Surety!
These were just some of the feelings that True Empress Katya could see when her eyes and Will gazed towards the True Emperor of this Age.
An existence that should have been chosen or allowed to become the True Emperor after much scrutiny from the Seers.
But he slipped through the cracks and attained what he did as now, he was undertaking actions fundamentally against what the Ancestors wished for!
HOONG!
A symphony of horns and drums rang out in the surroundings as this being arrived with fanfare, the aura he released putting all organisms on edge as what was maddening was its sheer numbers.
Five of him had appeared as when one looked at what should be his clones- each of them felt very real in terms of threat as if none were weaker than the others.
And even more terrible was that they each continued to show increasing levels of power!

This was attributed to the fantastical boons of his Lineage that were still transforming many things, with the level of strength Noah displayed constantly edging upwards as he arrived within the last Dimension he needed.

The authority of this Age would be saved for the last and final chance of Displacement as Noah planned to use this and the remaining True Authority of Quintessence to elevate his Boundaries to the most powerful levels after he discerned what would result from the fulfill attainment of the 9 Dimension and the utter freedom of the Desolate Mausoleum.

He would take the last and final dimensions with his own hands as while 5 bodies were here, a sixth one was swallowing the Quantum Dimension in another point of space as his goal here was an Ancestral Descendant Commander.
A True Emperor that not too long ago had granted a Clone of his True Death!

He gazed at the Imperial Karmic Scarab form she adorned exquisitely as in the next instant, the Ancestral Descendants could seemingly feel his hungry and greedy gazes towards their Commander as while some parried off the attacks of Eckert and the others, a tall Ancestral Descendant adorned in Bone Armaments that were enough tinged a radiant green exploded with power to stand in front of his Commander, his voice beginning to ring out powerfully!
"Watch how you gaze upon the True Emperor of Ka-"
BZZZT!
His words never finished.

In the middle of his sentence, the Prana Dimensional Chassis merely gazed at this Ancestral Descendant as his finger tapped the space in front of him, and the very Blood that coursed through the lips and will of this being lost their autonomy and control as he was shut up forcefully!
The gaze of the True Emperor of Quintessence was exceedingly cold and filled with regality.
His Will blanketed down on the Ancestral Descendant who was speaking before and currently shaking in shock along with all other Ancestral Descendants as his magnetic voice rang out with glory!
<I do not feel like giving extras too many lines to say today.>
WAA!
<So just stay on the sides and die silently.>
A profound sense of suppression descended as it became very clear at this moment..that something terrifying would bloom today!

As if to affirm this, the body of the Ancestral Descendant that was shut with a mere tap of a finger began to release a crimson gold radiance soon after, erupting into a blaze of bloody flames an instant later as the horror on his face was very pervasive before his Aspects of Existence were eradicated!
Katya saw this happen before her eyes as her True Authority began to tell her terrifying possibilities.
She had sown Karma when she killed a Clone of this being, and now, this Karma came to be collected.
As someone proficient in Karma, she could control and manipulate it to her favor, but all of this remained a mere possibility as seeing the state of power this being released...they had to act!
HOONG!
A vibrant verdant layer of light began to rise as she uttered calmly.
<Monolith of Life and Karma.>
A dazzling illusory tower like structure rose and encompassed everything in the surroundings as it protectively wrapped around the Pylon of Ascension.

The austere light of a Boundary vibrantly cascaded in the surroundings as the voice of Katya came out in somewhat of a hurried tone as she began to see the 5 bodies of the True Emperor of Quintessence begin to burn with cerulean flames as <Quintessential Singularity Ignition> was called forth!
<Do you understand the sheer gravity of your actions? What it truly means for you to do what you are doing?>
The removal of the Anchors that suppressed the Desolate Mausoleum.
Did this being stop for even a second to consider what would result from all this?

<With the suppression of the Natural Laws unleashed, they will go back to latch on to all organisms from these Planes of Existence. As they cannot easily be expanded towards EXTREMITY, these concepts become a limitation as our Aeonic Souls are not the only determinants of our power! No matter how strong one's soul is, they will have to walk along the lines and limitations of Manadynamics, Providence, and Continuity...it becomes that much harder to bend Reality to our willl They will latch onto us and take up precious space on our souls that could be occupied by the pristine authorities of Boundaries surging towards EXTREMITY! Have you truly not thought about any of this?!>
WAA!
Her Imperial Karmic Scarab began to blaze with green flames of Karma as well.

They cracked and reflected the cerulean flames beginning to form like surging tides of a torrential sea that would devour everything from 5 different sources- the one responsible for enacting them gazing towards the bellowing Katya coldly!
His voice began to rise amidst the flames that did nothing to his allies, but his enemies could feel their hear from afar.
<You all look at the Natural Laws of Reality as if they're a weakness. That..is your own mistake.>
<What you consider a weakness, I consider a source of strength!>
Noah's tyrannical will surged as it could be felt within his words, Katya's will gazing towards while astounded and angry at such an answer!

chapters.title: Chapter 2224 Merely A True Empress! II
paragraphs: 2224 Merely a True Empress! II

Katya scoffed at such an answer as the Ancestral Descendants below her burned the reserves of their Aeonic Souls to set up more protective shields, her verdant wisps of energy dancing on her exterior layers as a sharp voice continued to emanate from her!

<Countless lives that those in these Planes of Existence cannot compare to..have you truly not thought of this? Is your ideology truly so narrow? You would jeopardize the lives of countless Existences just to save a few? Any great leader and Commander knows that the lives of the many outweigh the few!>

<All for what? You remove the suppression on a Will of an emotionless Entity that isn't even alive? On the Will of a Plane of Existence that serves no purpose other than to follow cycles? Is a being like who you attained the True Throne truly thinking of the best future paths for yourself and others?!>
Her voice carried bountiful admonishments as she saw the torrential tides of the blue flames having covered everything.
She knew an attack was coming as she wasn't too sure of being capable to withstand it- needing to first face it before she could say for sure!
But towards her words, one of the bodies of the True Emperor of Quintessence turned their heads while looking at her quizzically.

<What exactly do you think will happen here as you shout all this? Do you think I'll suddenly feel a profound sense of epiphany from your words, pack up everything, and just move on? That everything I've done up until now would all be swayed by your few words?>
WAA!
The words were so supremely cold and callous that Katya could not retort.

<The Ancestors can manage to protect their precious Sacrariums even when the Natural Laws bind them again. If they are too weak to do so, that simply means they haven't been able to adapt this whole time in the Vaults of Extremity! As for you... truly meant it when I said extras shouldn't be saying so many lines today.>
HOONG!
Utter disrespect and flames surged forth as a True Emperor of an Age was termed an extra.
Within Noah's bodies, the Boundary of Blood surged as his clones seemed to light up with a crimson multicolored light.

He could do many things with Blood- and one of those was to accelerate it and the amount of power he could draw from it as on top of the over 102% Augmentation to All Aeonic Parameter Values from the Boundary of Loot, yet another 100% Augmentation bloomed as his Aeonic Damage Values that had topped a range of 300-400 doubled once more!

A range of 600-800 Aeonic Damage Values surged forward as even though it wasn't equivalent to what he saw Desiderius release against Yvonne, this Damage came from each Quintessential Dimensional Chassis.
Each!

And now 5 of them surrounded the dazzlingly enacted <Monolith of Life and Karma> called forth by Katya and supported by her and her Legion along with Hideyoshi's forces, Noah causing these torrential flames of Quintessential Singularity Ignition to surge down at the same time as he wanted them to experience a constant barrage of 600-800 Aeonic Damage Values, totaling to a range of 3000-4000 Aeonic Damage Values simultaneously and constantly so long as he kept these Flames active!
And his Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation provided the Essence for this freely as apart from all this...
<Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkrieg>.
<Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkrieg>...
Five horrific domains descended with their own Damage Values as the True Emperor of Quintessence..spammed.
Torrential waves of Aeonic Damage Values cascaded down in a terrific manner as if this was still not enough, the Haki of the True Emperor of Quintessence began to surge and emanate outwards.
The Haki that was truly an Emperor's Haki at this moment as it carried a unique type of Damage Value that Noah could cast freely- Aeonic Soul Damage Value.

Silent and deadly, augmented by the Boundaries of Loot and Blood to multiply multiple times over to reach 100 Aeonic Soul Damage Values..his Haki caused the surroundings space to tremble and buzz as it cascaded down on top of the raging flames of Quintessential Singularity Ignition and Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkriegs!
A true glory of spamming bloomed as this was Noah's answer towards an Ancestral Commander!
Reality melted under the heat of the flames.
It then fractured and turned to ash under the Haki of the True Emperor of Quintessence and hid descending domains!
And all of them..were centered towards a cluster of enemies that at this moment felt like an Apocalypse was heading towards them.
<Improbable...>
True Empress Katya felt her Aeonic Soul tremble as torrential waves closed in all at once.

The <Monolith of Life and Karma> instantly melted before the waves of surging flames and domains as the bodies of the Ancestral Descendants in her Legion and of Hideyoshi's..their eyes instantly turned blank as a wave of Soul Power smashed onto their souls!
In an exceedingly short period of time, Katya felt so very alone.
And at such a juncture, her Boundary of Karma bubbled forth.
"YAAA!"

A bellow erupted from her as the antennas on her head radiated light, seeing countless lines of Karma rising and connecting to everything as she sought the Lines of Karma from the True Emperor of Quintessence.
<Innumerable Karmic Resonance>.
So long as she could cut the Karma connecting him and his skills, she could...
SHIING!
Her eyes and Will trembled.
She gazed at the Karma of this being as just when illusory scissors born of Karma were ready to cut off the Lines of Karma connected to this being..these scissors shattered.
Because the Lines of Karma this being had were simply...
<So big...>
This was the thought in True Empress Katya as she was barely able to glimpse the Karma of this being while pushing her Fourth Boundary Layer of Karma to its absolute Limit.
The Karma surrounding this being was too potent and too massive for someone like her to even think of cutting.
She felt like she could define it, but at the same time...it seemed to be Undefined!
This was the thought she had.
It was also the last thought to occupy her mind as the stacked up Aeonic Damage Values that exceeded 3,000 from the Quintessential Singularity Ignitions alone shredded away all defensive Layers.
The Magistracy of the Apocalyptic Blitzkriegs and never ending waves of Haki releasing Soul Damage did the rest!

It meant that in the span of a fraction of a nanosecond, an Ancestral Descendant was reigning powerfully and full of life force as in the next second..her Will and Aspects of Existence were shattered.
Billowing torrential flames raged and wrapped around this area with the Pylon of Ascension at its center, the origin of these flames barely being discernable as his magnetic voice could be heard.
<Merely a True Empress....>
WAA!
Mass release is in preparation andshould be out sometime in thecoming days!

chapters.title: Chapter 2225 Freedom! I
paragraphs: 2225 Freedom! I
A scene of Cataclysm as Reality itself melted!
Torrential flames from 5 sides flagged down and torched everything, and they were layered with the Haki and domains of the True Emperor of Quintessence as the targets within this area...
Faced utter eradication.
It mattered not whether they were mere Descendants or Ancestral Descendant Commander!
A True Empress perished in this move as the last she saw were the lines of Karma surging around Noah- lines so thick and unbreakable as he had connected himself to too many beings!

ραпdα---nᴏνa| сom This was directly opposite to what many powerful existences chose to do in terms of Karma- where they did their best to cut off any Karmic connections to others so that they weren't used against them in the future.
Yet the True Emperor of Quintessence....he walked a much different path as he was on his way to be connected to the countless lives within 9 Minor Planes and a Major Plane of Existence.
CRACK!

The crackling flames died down as what was left behind were scorched bodies whose Blood began to burst out from with grandiosity, rivers of crimson gold stellar blood beginning to flow towards the being responsible for their deaths as the Quintessential Dimensional Chassis opened their mouths to devour everything.

They devoured everything as it was taken back to the main body- the normal method of attaining Loot that would have granted Quintessential Treasure Caches momentarily stopped as Noah pulled everything about the Aspects of Existence of these beings through their Blood!
And the results were stellar.
<Blood with high potency in the selected Boundary of Fate has been devoured. Progression towards achieving the First Boundary Layer of Fate is at 90%.>

Another Boundary went towards the first Layer with ease as Noah still needed to face more of Hideyoshi's forces- with all the remaining ones being with him in the Boundary Between Realities where Noah had sent him and Desiderius to face the one known as Theseus!
So Fate was not attained at this juncture, but the Boundary that the True Empress of Karma birthed when she took the True Throne of Karma many cycles ago was different.
<Blood with high potency in the selected Boundary of Karma has been devoured. Progression towards achieving the First Boundary Layer of Karma is at 65%...>
The vibrant rivers of Blood from the subordinates of True Empress Katya were fantastical enough, but when Noah devoured the stellar blood of the Imperial Karmic Scarab that was Katya herself...
<Extremely potent Blood of the Existence that birthed the selected Boundary of Karma has been devoured!>
<The potent Blood contains deep accumulations of the selected Boundary as the First Boundary Layer of Karma has been exceeded, and the path to the Second Boundary Layer of Karma is extremely close!>

Stellar crimson radiance overflowed as from the massive body of the Imperial Karmic Scarab, rivers of bubbling blood flew out as the verdant gold Layers of this beastial body began to turn ashen gray, eventually turning into dust as everything about it was milked out.
And when he devoured everything about this True Empress...

<The complete Absorption of a True Emperor of an Age of the Barren Lands has sparked a quintessential effect, the True Authority of Karma stretched to become a Boundary resonating with the current True Authority of Quintessence.>
<The effect of the devoured Blood has been amplified Quintessentially.>
<The Second Boundary Layer of Karma has been attained!>
<A Quintessential quality of the Boundaries attained through the devouring of Blood has been discovered.>

<All Boundaries obtained through the complete Absorption of Blood are transformed into Boundaries completely unique to the Quintessential Kainos Emperor as they course through your Blood where Quintessence reigns, and they course through the Boundary of Blood that was born from Quintessence.>
WAA!
The stellar blood of an Ancestral Descendant Commander was glorious beyond measure.
Her uniqueness made a wondrous succession of events possible as after devouring everything about her, Noah couldn't help but smack his lips!
But it wasn't just her uniqueness.
There was also himself.
When he attained the Boundaries that other beings created... they would be transformed under him into something else as they were propelled forward by his factor of Quintessence!

It meant that whatever the Layers of Karma, Death, Fate, or any others that Noah would gain from others. ..his Boundary Layers of these concepts would range from being slightly different to future Boundaries granting entirely different and more spectacular effects.
This was a byproduct of his own grandness!

The sheer gravity of what he had just done settled in as amidst the bodies of the Ancestral Descendants turning to ash, his gaze and the gazes of those around him went towards the very center where one thing still remained.
The Pylon of Ascension.
The tool that the Ancestors utilized for safe passage across the Planar Palisades of Extremity!

It took one across a pathway that was relatively free of danger as now that Noah attained memories of it...he could truly see its uniqueness as he realized destroying it may have been an impossibility.
It could be affected.

One could disrupt its functions like the descending of the VOID had done. But its destruction would take some time as this... was a unique construct that was among the treasures the Ancestors had found in the Vaults of Extremity!
A construct that connected one point of space to another, with the Pylon of Ascension here simply being the lesser part of this construct as its main piece was on the other side.
At the center of a Sacrarium of the Ancestors where those Ascending would always reach!
It was something one had to move around with a great level of care, but Noah...
<Devour it all.>
HUUM!
The Pocket Dimensional Reality that had been devouring the Quantum Dimension this whole time became even more domineering as only a few light years of this Dimension remained.
And now, the hungry light of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality turned itself towards the last remaining vestiges of the Quantum Dimension.
A greedy light covered the Pylon of Ascension and its stellar hourglass form!

chapters.title: Chapter 2226 Freedom! II
paragraphs: 2226 Freedom! II
There was an eerie level of calm amidst the extremely tumultuous time to come.
<What do you think?>
Noah's voice echoed out amidst this calm as his Main Body that was seated on the True Throne of Quintessence asked lightly.
The one being asked was no other than the Source of Reality.

<Katya asked why I cared enough to remove the suppression on an emotionless Entity that isn't even alive. A mere construct undergoing cycles of death and Rebirth. Tell me... do you feel anything now as the last Anchor is about to be removed?>
The waves of plasmic light had only gotten ridiculously more and more radiant over the last few minutes as more and more Anchors were released.
The Source of Reality looked even more radiant as Noah did not doubt that the Enders of Nature had reached a shocking level.
So the Will behind it all...
<<I feel.>>
WAA!
The resonant voice gave a shocking and very short answer.
It didn't say exactly what it felt, but it said that it could feel! It felt when its own people suppressed it Ages ago and greatly wounded its Source.
It felt when its Will moved with more autonomy in the Last Age as Primordial Beasts and Enders of Nature came to be!
It felt when it learned from the actions every True Emperor of an Age took when they had the opportunity to release its suppression but didn't.
So was it truly an emotionless Entity simply filled with the need for survival?
SHIING!
Noah smiled while seated on his Throne as he could see the Source of Reality release pillars of multicolored plasmic waves of light at this moment.
<The devouring and assimilation of the Quantum Dimension is 90% completed...>
The Last Anchor was nearly out as Reality was about to erupt to its full power.
It was about to have its freedom!

After countless Ages and cycles, its Will had been transformed into something else entirely as if one looked at it before the Age of Genesis and now...the Fundamental changes that had occurred would truly be unfathomable.
Noah gazed at this surging Will that continued to scale upwards in power and autonomy as his voice continued to ring out.
<Have you thought about what comes after this? About what happens after I have devoured all 9 Dimensions?>
pαndα---noνɐ1,сoМ His voice filled with authority was magnetic.
The Will of Reality didn't even pause before replying.
<<Your ravenous Will knows no bounds. You devour and devour endlessly everything that is before you, not at all caring of the consequences. There will come a time when you will grow too full.>>
Its words were cryptic as Noah smiled at them, simply giving a nod as both parties were on the same page!
<A time where I will grow too full...maybe. But it is not today!>

<You've changed, but you are still a logical construct similar to the 9 Minor Planes. Since you know what the Ancestors will do once your Laws bind them again after failing to destroy you now...will you resist what I wish to do?>
His ravenous will.
His hunger that knew no bounds!
Even without stating it, it was supremely clear what he wanted to do!
And the Source of Reality...

<<I will not need to be coaxed akin to a budding Will of any common Plane. Since I cannot devour the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, I will merge with it and gain even more autonomy. With it, I should be able to remove the fixation placed upon me and gain the autonomy to move freely. And it is still unknown whether the construct of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality can even handle the entirety of 9 Minor Planes and a Major Plane of Existence as when it comes to who will be in control when everything is over...>>
WAA!
The words of the Source of Reality were glorious and terrifying to hear all at once, Noah's smile only becoming deeper as the prompt both of these entities were waiting for came.
<The devouring and assimilation of the Quantum Dimension is 100% completed.>
<An Irreversible Nexus Event has occurred!>
<You have accomplished successive Nexus Events and have risen to stand at the very peak of True Emperors across the Ages!>
<The Source of Reality flourishes with freedom and releases all residual Authority of this Age and Ages past due to your accomplishments.>
HOONG!
A light that seemed to stretch across endless horizons.
A light that bathed the Source of Reality and everything else across the fabric of Reality as all pertinent beings felt this light and raised their heads to see.
In the Boundary Between Realities, torrential waves of Natural Laws raged and wrapped around everything as the blank void looked radiant with Seas of essence.
In a corner of the Boundary Between Realities, a sword cry could be heard as trillions of illusory sword waves that looked like cosmic rain cascaded down towards a VOID Singularity.

A singularity that had transformed into Obsidian tendrils of light that erupted out and filled everything reminiscent of countess tentacles of horrific light that smashed towards the cosmic rain of sword with glory!
The one responsible for this void turned his head towards a certain direction and smiled.
"What a fantastical Key this was. ..to have completed all my work for me!"
His ancient voice was boisterous as he reacted in his own way.
Then, Hideyoshi and Theseus also saw this blinding light as well as the intensity of the Natural Laws of Nature becoming maddeningly tight, their hearts also realizing what had happened!
Hideyoshi seemed shocked and unresolved at such a result.
While Theseus...a trace of anger appeared in his pure eyes.
For him to allow this to happen while he was here personally. ..his Lineage could not stand it!
CAAA!
His Aeonic Soul cried out.
The sword he held...dissolved into pure light and merged with him.

The light of this Boundary became astonishing as the smile on the 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE actually faded, the countless tentacles becoming even more resplendent as be looked over this direction in genuine surprise.
A question that gave hints to many shocking things to come.
A question that Theseus answered with three words.
<Plane Dissecting Sword>.
The surrounding fabric of Reality that was returning to full power cried out as a blow that could dissect a Plane of Existence itself bloomed out at this critical moment!
At a moment of wonder and majesty as the 9 Minor Planes suppressing the Desolate Mausoleum... were all removed!

chapters.title: Chapter 2227 The Rebirth Of The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!
paragraphs: 2227 The Rebirth of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality!
Every part of what used to be the Quantum Dimension was devoured and reforged within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
Every part.

But there was one construct that was within this Minor Plane that took just a little bit longer- the devouring force from the Pocket Dimensional Reality being slowed down as this point of Infinite mass and density provided great resistance!
<A type of Unidentified Naturally Occurring Epochal Relic has begun the process of devouring and assimilation.>
<A possibility of full re-emergence and control of the Relic after assimilation into the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality is likely.>
WAA!

New possibilities arose right after as they all lay with the capabilities of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality that had devoured every remaining part of 9 Minor Planes and placed them inside it, with its greedy light now turned to a construct placed in one of these domains by the Ancestors as Fundamental changes were taking place in its core.
Just what did it mean to have 9 Minor Planes devoured and assimilated into a single construct?
How exactly could one even quantify it?

For the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, waves of unimaginable changes bloomed every second- with every part of its current stellar bodies and Cosmos being bathed with radiant light and expanding, while the established devoured Planes also shone with an incandescent glint while also being expanded!
The one factor that didn't need quantification to be stated...was that the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality was becoming terrifically massive and ever expansive.
And Reality showed this in the best way it could!
<The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality is undergoing a type of Irreversible Nexus Event that cannot be reversed across the spacetime continuum.>
<Its Source has seamlessly assimilated the Sources of 9 Minor Planes and reforged them under its control.>
<The devouring and assimilation of the Source of Reality has now begun!>
Yes.
Countless changes were blooming, but Noah didn't leave it there!
In the location filled with plasmic auroras of Natural Laws, he had released a focal point of a Pocket Dimensional Reality that had begun to devour the very essence of Reality here.
The very Source of Reality after it ascertained that he was planning on devouring everything.
It caused a unique phenomenon to unfold where just as the fabric of Reality regained its freedom after Eons, its Source was about to be merged into another source entirely right after!
Its Source was far vaster and now much more radiant than any of the Minor Planes, and something fantastical occurred the moment that Noah began devouring its Source.

He could feel through his connection with the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality that streaks of rivers of Reality his Will wasn't bringing with the Authority of the Infinity Dream...they began to rush into and assimilate with the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
Since its very Source was being devoured and assimilated, so would the actual fabric of Reality!
The vast Realities across the Desolate Mausoleum.
The Boundary Between Realities.
Every part of the very fabric of Reality began to be drawn into the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
<Good...>

Noah could feel the vibrant waves of Destiny and Providence as his own concepts surging towards EXTREMITY pulsed wondrously for the future, expressing that great changes that would greatly steer Noah's path were coming from this event!
And Noah himself was at the forefront of this as just moments after the Quantum Dimension was assimilated into the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality...
<You have successfully Bound the Source of Quantum.>
For the 9th time, he went in the opposite direction of others and bound the Source of a Dimension to himself.
He bound the last and final Source of a Dimension as even this was achieved...
HOOONG!
The Resonance his Origin could already feel a while ago as it stated that the second requirement for the birth of an Innate Boundary was unveiled.
<The 9 Bound Dimensional Sources within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality are reacting to the 9 Dimensional Realities in your Origin.>
<The Source of Reality within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality is reacting to the 9 Dimensional Realities in your Origin.>
<The 9 Quintessential Dimensional Chassis born from your Dimensional Realities are undergoing Quintessential Resonance!>
<The Blood that connects the 9 True Sanguine Clones that became Quintessential Dimensional Chassis cries out and begins to steer the Resonance!>
<The Boundary of Blood permeates its authority across this process of Resonance and wishes to walk closer towards EXTREMITY!>
<The Boundary of Quintessence surging through your Blood and all Aspects of your Existence permeates its authority across this process of Resonance and wishes to walk closer towards EXTREMITY!>
Shocking and unimaginable changes were blooming at this very moment when Noah achieved the complete binding of all 9 Dimensions!
Quintessence was an evolvable Boundary whose Tier wasn't fixed.
Fantastically, it also brought itself forward to try its elevation on top of the Boundary of Blood as it truly did permeate across all aspects of Noah's existence!
eαglesnᴏνel But this wasn't all.
<The Boundary of Loot cries out!>
<The concept of Loot closely linked to the very core of your Being seeks to also advance forward through this magisterial process!>
LOOT also joined the fray as Noah's very first Boundary as it rode on this bus of Quintessence towards an unknown destination!
But...
<Due to the convergence of Conceptual Boundaries, much more authority is required to achieve the results they seek.>

It was only supposed to be the Boundary of Blood that closely connected Noah's True Sanguine Clones and 9 Dimensional Reality that now resonated with the 9 Sources of Dimensions in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
But Quintessence and Loot forced themselves into the picture as the required authority was raised to an abnormal level!
Yet Noah's will did not falter as there was a solution even for this.
He gazed at the prompt that came at the moment that he pulled the last Anchor from the Desolate Mausoleum.
<The Source of Reality flourishes with freedom and releases all residual Authority of this Age and Ages past due to your accomplishments.>

Due to his grand accomplishments, the Source of Reality had released the residual True Authority of Quintessence, True Authority of Destiny, True Authority of Terror...the True Authority of every Age across the Eons all the way back to the Age of Genesis!

<The Source of Reality within the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality is reacting to the 9 Dimensional Realities in your Origin.>
<The 9 Quintessential Dimensional Chassis born from your Dimensional Realities are undergoing Quintessential Resonance!>
<The Blood that connects the 9 True Sanguine Clones that became Quintessential Dimensional Chassis cries out and begins to steer the Resonance!>
<The Boundary of Blood permeates its authority across this process of Resonance and wishes to walk closer towards EXTREMITY!>
<The Boundary of Quintessence surging through your Blood and all Aspects of your Existence permeates its authority across this process of Resonance and wishes to walk closer towards EXTREMITY!>
Shocking and unimaginable changes were blooming at this very moment when Noah achieved the complete binding of all 9 Dimensions!
Quintessence was an evolvable Boundary whose Tier wasn't fixed.
Fantastically, it also brought itself forward to try its elevation on top of the Boundary of Blood as it truly did permeate across all aspects of Noah's existence!
eαglesnᴏνel But this wasn't all.
<The Boundary of Loot cries out!>
<The concept of Loot closely linked to the very core of your Being seeks to also advance forward through this magisterial process!>
LOOT also joined the fray as Noah's very first Boundary as it rode on this bus of Quintessence towards an unknown destination!
But...
<Due to the convergence of Conceptual Boundaries, much more authority is required to achieve the results they seek.>

It was only supposed to be the Boundary of Blood that closely connected Noah's True Sanguine Clones and 9 Dimensional Reality that now resonated with the 9 Sources of Dimensions in the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality.
But Quintessence and Loot forced themselves into the picture as the required authority was raised to an abnormal level!
Yet Noah's will did not falter as there was a solution even for this.
He gazed at the prompt that came at the moment that he pulled the last Anchor from the Desolate Mausoleum.
<The Source of Reality flourishes with freedom and releases all residual Authority of this Age and Ages past due to your accomplishments.>

Due to his grand accomplishments, the Source of Reality had released the residual True Authority of Quintessence, True Authority of Destiny, True Authority of Terror...the True Authority of every Age across the Eons all the way back to the Age of Genesis!

chapters.title: Chapter 2228 The Rebirth Of The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality! II
paragraphs: 2228 The Rebirth of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality! II
Authority across the Ages was released because of Noah's actions.
Residual authority, yes.
But still, it was a cast cluster of authority across the Ages.
HOONG!
A glorious symphony continued to increase in cadence and melody as Noah's will surged commandingly to take this authority and apply it to the unreliable process already occurring right now.
<Dense reserves of True Authorities have entered the fray of Quintessential Resonance!>
<Your Planar Lineage of the Quintessential Kainos Emperor calls forth its Irreversible Nexus Association with the Boundary of Blood.>
<The Boundary of Blood seeks to become intricately connected to your Bloodline and achieve the stage of an Innate Boundary!>
<The Boundaries of Loot and Quintessence seek to become intricately connected to your Bloodline and achieve the stage of an Innate Boundary!>
<Your Quintessential Kainos Emperor Lineage undergoes further evolution!>
"Holy..."

An array of too many prompts rained down one after another as Noah's Origin was currently radiating a light...that was even more intense than the radiant Source of Reality being devoured in front of him.
He couldn't truly describe the Resonance he felt that was currently ongoing with his Dimensional Realities, the 9 Bound Dimension, and his 9 Dimensional Chassis.
He wouldn't be able to vocalize what was truly happening!

He could only say it was pulsing waves of Resonance constantly pushing and pulling amongst each other as dense waves of True Authority across the Ages mixed in along with his forged concepts that sought EXTREMITY.

He was benefiting greatly from all this as his Aeonic Soul surged upwards in power, while his Aeonic Quintessential Kainos Empyral Foundation became even more solidified with his Realm...feeling more complete as his Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality also went towards completely devouring all Dimensions and Reality.

He could feel many things as it was already too much, but he began to feel something else entirely blooming at the very center of this Resonance between his Dimensional Realities and Sources of 9 Dimensions.
Between his Planar Realities and 9 Minor Planes of Existence!
What bloomed...was fantastically the light of a Boundary.
<A concept of Extremity is being born from the Quintessential Resonance of Dimensions and Reality!>
<The Boundary of Dimensions seeks to come to fruition.>
Utter majesty and grandeur came as unimaginable possibilities bloomed during this critical process.
This process...that didn't just involve Noah alone.
It also critically involved another Entity that had undergone countless Cycles- an entity that now had immense autonomy compared to before, and was already amassing its own forces.

Even now as its Source was being devoured, its Will and autonomy were still retained as when parts of it continued to be absorbed into the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality, it found itself gaining even greater levels of Autonomy!
And now, in its prime state after being freed, it conducted another move to protect itself and ensure its future.

In the foldings of Reality, countless Enders of Nature could be seen as many of them now had five or more Natural Laws surging within their Origins, their power reaching spectacular levels while the Anchors were being removed from Reality!

At the very forefront of these Legions of Enders of Nature, the Draconian Qilin Phoenix could be seen as at this moment, its core swirled with intense waves of Manadynamics, Entropy, Providence, Relativity, Continuity, and Isochronism.
It had been perfectly placed with all 6 Fundamental Natural Laws as it boasted extreme power, but the Source of Reality held back its progression at this moment.
eαglesnᴏνel It felt its expanded autonomy.
It felt the countless changes across Reality.
It waded through countless waves of knowledge over the eons.
And this Will of a Major Plane of Existence...took an entirely different route than anything expected of it.
No other Major Plane of Existence would have ever gained such a high level of autonomy.
No other Major Planes of Existence had undergone as many things as it had over the eons!

After a confluence of many factors, a shocking move was done that across the Unrecorded History of the Vaults of Extremity and the Planar Palisades of Extremity surrounding it...it was hard to say if it had occurred before.

The Draconian Qilin Phoenix shut its eyes as from its body, one could feel the waves of authority from the Fundamental Natural Laws of Entropy, Relativity, Providence, Continuity, and Isochronism all begin to fade.
Until the only thing left behind was Manadynamics.

And then hereafter, the vast stretches of authority under the control of this Major Plane of Existence... surged towards this last remaining Modus Operandi of Manadynamics inside the body of this Ender of Nature as this concept began to be expanded!

The Source of Reality horrifically focused its authority onto a singular concept of its Natural Laws as on this day, for the first time ever...it expanded one of the concepts that governed it towards EXTREMITY.
The concepts that Ancestors left behind and considered too hard to stretch towards EXTREMITY.
On this day, the Desolate Mausoleum took it upon itself to expand them to never before seen heights of power!
HOONG!

A sorrowful symphony of great power and change began to play as an Entity was pushed and placed under great levels of stress for eons. And after all this time, the culmination of all these stresses gave way to unbelievable possibilities.
As the Source of Reality did this, the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality that it was merging with sensed the profound changes as it instantly reported them to its Master.
The Master that was in the midst of his own Quintessential changes as his tyrannical will lit up with even more radiance.
Because the actions of the Will of Reality opened many paths and made one thing abundantly clear for Noah.
On his path towards EXTREMITY, he would not be alone!
He would have the support of a whole Plane of Existence among even more glorious constructs on his way towards EXTREMITY!
And he was still trying to grasp the explosion of information and wonder from his own Resonance as multiple concepts sought a pathway towards becoming Innate Boundaries!

chapters.title: Chapter 2229 The Rebirth Of The Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality! III
paragraphs: 2229 The Rebirth of the Gourmandizing Dimensional Reality! III
Plane Dissecting Sword.
These were the words that Theseus had called out as they caused genuine surprise to show from the ancient visage of the 8 Echelon Obsidian NOBLESSE, Desiderius!
He was of the 8 Echelon Obsidian ranking this being had 8 Boundaries under him, and the Obsidian title distinguished that had achieved at least 4 Boundary Layers in a majority of these 8 Boundaries.
At the least.

He and all others would remain in the <Obsidian> stage of Boundary Layers so long as they never reached the 6th Boundary Layer, where any being who brought a Boundary to such a height would be termed a 1 Echelon Crimson Existence!
But having an Aeonic Soul capable of taking any Concept of Extremity to the 6th Boundary Layer was exceedingly hard.

This staging was a demarcation of those who had become truly adept at using their Aeonic Soul, reaching a level of manipulation of Boundaries to alter the reality around them to an unimaginable extent.

It was common knowledge in the Vaults of Extremity that any Boundary could not be taken to the 6th Boundary Layer unless the existence trying to do so had their Aeonic Soul supported by 9 Boundaries that had all achieved the 5th Boundary Layer!

Their Aeonic Soul had to have been refined to a ridiculous level as only when it had the augmentations and boons of 9 different Boundaries at the 5th Boundary Layer did they have a chance to succeed in taking one of their Boundaries to the 6th Layer- an extremely high Aeonic Soul Value was just one requirement!
Normally.
But...there were always exceptions.
There were beings who put off any other Concepts and only focused on a single Boundary to bring towards Extremity.

Such beings had a high level of fanaticism towards their Concepts, and they defied set norms as they refined their Aeonic Soul with a single Boundary, spending countless years smashing towards the 6th Boundary Layer of their single concept as more often than not, they would never reach it.
But there were geniuses out there.
There were special existences born in unique conditions.
There were also a myriad of unknown treasures within the Vaults of Extremity that could change established norms.
Desiderius knew this.
He knew that before reaching the 6th Boundary Layer, the control existences had over their Aeonic Soul was elementary.

It was rough and without direction as only when one could utilize their Aeonic Soul with a great level of control and manipulate it in unfathomable ways...did the path towards the 6th Boundary Layer and above open up!
It was why so many other Layers were needed as support to refine and strengthen the Aeonic Soul!
Desiderius knew this, and it was why he was all the more surprised when the Ancestral Descendant known as Theseus called out <Plane Dissecting Sword>!
The sword this being held in his hands disappeared and merged into his body.
Truthfully, it merged with his Aeonic Soul.
Because from this point onward, this being would never need an external weapon to express the Boundary of the Sword!
SHIING!
His dark hair whipped madly as every strand seemed like a sharp stellar sword.

The pupils within his eyes took on the form of white-gold swords as his body became adorned with wisps of the authority of the Boundary of the Sword, a white-gold Armament etched with radiant sword light covering him entirely!
White gold.

This was the color this being gave off as at this moment, his whole body blazed with immense sharpness as one could see the illusion of a sword hilt below his feet, and a blade rising from his body and above his head with a sharp sword point!
His very existence felt like a Sword as he blared forth with a light that fantastically....
HOONG!
Caused the dark VOID in the surroundings to retreat for light years.
The surroundings instantly brightened up as the stellar seas of natural laws became visible to all- the blanket of the VOID entirely canceled!
This was because Theseus had managed to reach a stage that was the same...or exceeding the one who had laid down the VOID.
Desiderius knew this very well!
That this being...had somehow begun to walk towards the abstruse and unreachable 6th Boundary Layer of the Sword.
Whether through sheer willpower or genius, whether through unknown treasures, means, or Lineages.

Theseus neared the unattainable 6th Boundary Layer as the clearest distinction of this was that the sharpness he was currently giving off...over half of it was in the form of Aeonic Soul Damage Values.
And it was in the thousands!
Yes!
The Hallmark of anyone reaching the 6th Boundary Layer towards EXTREMITY...was that everything they released would contain Aeonic Soul Damage Value!
The difference in the manipulation and control of the Aeonic Soul from the 5th to the 6th Boundary was akin to the control of a child compared to an adult.
SHIING!
So Theseus drew himself and shot forth.
And the smile on Desiderius only became wilder as the love for battle and supremacy of the NOBLESSE Lineage roused maddeningly!

On the side, the golden grandeur of fate overflowed as Hideyoshi and his Legion gazed on in utter shock, where they didn't seem capable of holding even a candle to the level of battle blooming before them.

Such a fight was witnessed by very few eyes, but the most important ones were the eyes of Reality itself, and the eyes of the True Emperor of Quintessence as he gauged the power of his enemies and what he himself had to achieve in order to overcome them.
eaglesnovɐ1,сoМ And uniquely, he seemed to have come across two particularly powerful enemies as it seemed Desiderius was not the only possible threat!
It made him question whether all the boons that were trying to come to fruition right now would be enough.
Whether the Boundaries trying to become Innate or the sudden appearance of a New Boundary arising from his Origin and Construct would be enough!
